default_profile_set.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Default button: status-bar success message shown after marking the selected import profile as the default, which then applies automatically whenever importing into that table. {schema_name}.{table_name} is the target table.

delimiter_comma.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → delimiter options: chip that selects comma as the delimited-file separator.

delimiter_label.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → delimiter options: label to the left of the comma, semicolon, tab, and pipe selector chips.

delimiter_pipe.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → delimiter options: chip that selects the pipe character as the delimited-file separator.

delimiter_semicolon.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → delimiter options: chip that selects semicolon as the delimited-file separator.

delimiter_tab.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → delimiter options: chip that selects tab as the delimited-file separator.

dialog_title.location: Results → Import / Export dialog: title at the top of the script-first import and export wizard.

empty_preview.value: 選擇 CSV、JSON、Excel (.xlsx, .xls) 或 .sqllyexport 檔案以在此預覽。
empty_preview.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → preview pane: desktop empty state shown before a supported import file has been chosen.

export_select_button.value: 匯出 SELECT 指令腳本
export_select_button.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → footer: button that scripts a SELECT statement for exporting the target table.

export_table_required.value: 先命名要匯出的資料表
export_table_required.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Script Export SELECT button: status-bar message shown when the button is clicked while the target table name field is empty.

file_and_target_required.value: 先選擇檔案與目標資料表
file_and_target_required.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Script Import to Editor button: status-bar message shown when no import script can be generated yet because no file (or pasted data) or no target table has been given.

file_read_failed.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red error shown when the chosen import file cannot be opened or read from disk. {error} is the operating-system error text.

file_size_limit.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red error shown when the chosen import file is larger than the 64 MiB import limit.

first_row_header.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → source options: checkbox that treats the first delimited-file row as column headers.

invalid_cell_type.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Rejected-rows warning: short reason fragment explaining why a row is rejected, shown in brackets after the offending value and in the generated script comment. {expected_type} is the column’s type keyword (int, date, uuid…); lowercase, no period.

invalid_json.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error shown when the chosen .json import file is not valid JSON. {error} is the parser’s technical detail.

invalid_sqlly_export.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error (also a status-bar error when opening a .sqllyexport file or saved snapshot) shown when a SQLLY Export file is not valid JSON or lacks required fields. {error} is the parser detail.

invalid_sqlly_export_cell.value: SQLLY 匯出儲存格必須為 null、布林值、數字、字串或 $bytes
invalid_sqlly_export_cell.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error (also shown in the status bar when opening a .sqllyexport file) when a cell in a SQLLY Export file is an unsupported JSON value such as an array or object. Keep “$bytes” literal.

json_array_required.value: 預期為物件的 JSON 陣列
json_array_required.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error shown when a .json import file is neither an array of objects nor an object wrapping such an array.

json_elements_must_be_objects.value: JSON 陣列的每個元素必須是物件
json_elements_must_be_objects.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error shown when a .json import file’s array contains an item that is not an object (for example a number or a nested array).

loading_preview.value: 正在背景讀取並解析匯入...
loading_preview.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → preview pane: status shown while the selected import is read and parsed in the background.

mapping_all_columns_skipped.value: 欄位對應忽略了每個來源欄位
mapping_all_columns_skipped.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Column mapping field: red validation error below the inputs when every entry in the mapping is “-”, so no source column would be imported.

mapping_bulk_insert_warning.value: 欄位對應僅適用於已複查的 INSERT 腳本；請清除它或從批次插入切換。
mapping_bulk_insert_warning.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → mapping controls: warning shown when a nonempty column mapping is incompatible with BULK INSERT.

mapping_count_mismatch.value: 欄位對應有 {entry_count} 個條目；檔案有 {column_count} 欄位
mapping_count_mismatch.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Column mapping field: red validation error below the inputs when the comma-separated mapping has a different number of entries than the file has columns. {entry_count} is entries typed; {column_count} is source columns.

mapping_dropped_columns.value: 來源欄位 {column_names} 不在此檔案中 — 它們的對應已被刪除
mapping_dropped_columns.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Profile notice: note listed after applying a saved profile whose mapping named source columns missing from the current file, so those mappings were dropped. {column_names} is a comma-separated list; lowercase fragment joined with other notes.

mapping_duplicate_target.value: 目標欄位 {target_name} 被對應多次
mapping_duplicate_target.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Column mapping field: red validation error below the inputs when two entries in the mapping name the same target column (case-insensitive). {target_name} is the repeated column name.

mapping_missing_target.value: 對應的欄位 {column_number} 沒有目標名稱
mapping_missing_target.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Column mapping field: red validation error below the inputs when an entry in the comma-separated mapping is blank instead of a target name or “-”. {column_number} is that entry’s 1-based position.

mapping_new_columns_skipped.value: 新的來源欄位 {column_names} 被跳過 (-) — 如果資料表有它們就對應它們
mapping_new_columns_skipped.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Profile notice: note listed after applying a saved profile when the file has source columns the profile did not know, which are mapped to “-” (skipped). {column_names} is a comma-separated list; lowercase fragment; keep “(-)”.

mapping_placeholder.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Column mapping input: placeholder showing the comma-separated syntax, one target column name per source column, with “-” to skip a column. The sample identifiers and “-” may stay as-is; translate only “Optional”.

no_file_chosen.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Source line beside the file chooser: text shown before any file has been chosen or data pasted, in place of the source file path.

null_token_label.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → mapping controls: label to the left of the optional input for text that represents NULL.

null_token_placeholder.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Null token input: placeholder for the optional text that should be read as SQL NULL when found in a cell. Keep the example “NULL” untranslated.

number_out_of_range.value: 數字超出 SQLLY 支援的範圍
number_out_of_range.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error (also a status-bar error when opening a .sqllyexport file) shown when a numeric cell in a SQLLY Export file is too large or not finite for SQLLY to hold.

paste_clipboard_button.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → source toolbar: desktop button that imports delimited text from the clipboard.

preview_footer.value: {data_row_count} 筆資料列 · 腳本在新分頁中開啟以供檢視 — 從這裡不會執行任何程式
preview_footer.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → footer: row-count and script-safety note shown when every data row fits in the preview.

preview_footer_limited.value: 預覽前 {preview_row_count} 筆，共 {data_row_count} 筆資料列 · 腳本在新分頁中開啟以供檢視 — 從這裡不會執行任何程式
preview_footer_limited.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → footer: truncated-preview counts and script-safety note shown when the import has more rows than the preview displays.

profile_connection_required.value: 匯入設定檔屬於已儲存的連線 — 從其中開啟精靈
profile_connection_required.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Save button: status-bar message shown when saving a profile from a wizard not opened from a saved connection, since profiles are stored per connection.

profile_default_button.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → profile controls: button that toggles the selected import profile as the default for the target table.

profile_delete_button.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → profile controls: button that deletes the selected import profile.

profile_deleted.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Delete button: status-bar success message shown after the selected import profile is deleted.

profile_drift_notice.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles row: notice line under the profile controls shown after a saved profile is applied but parts of it no longer fit the current file. {profile_name} is the profile; {notices} is a semicolon-separated list of the issues.

profile_name_placeholder.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles row: placeholder in the text input where the user types a name for saving or renaming an import profile.

profile_name_required.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Save button: status-bar message shown when Save is clicked while the profile name input is empty.

profile_rename_button.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → profile controls: button that renames the selected import profile to the entered profile name.

profile_renamed.value: 已將設定檔重新命名為 '{profile_name}'
profile_renamed.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Rename button: status-bar success message shown after the selected import profile is renamed. {profile_name} is the new name.

profile_save_button.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → profile controls: button that saves the current import settings under the entered profile name.

profile_saved.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Save button: status-bar success message shown after the wizard’s current settings are saved as an import profile (overwriting one of the same name). {profile_name} is its name.

profile_selection_required.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Rename, Delete, or Default button: status-bar message shown when one of those buttons is clicked while no profile is selected in the profile dropdown.

profile_sheet_missing.value: 工作表 '{sheet_name}' 不在此活頁簿中
profile_sheet_missing.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Profile notice: note listed after applying a saved profile that names an Excel sheet not present in the chosen workbook. {sheet_name} is that sheet; lowercase fragment joined with other notes.

profile_target_required.value: 首先設定目標表 — 配置檔限定於它
profile_target_required.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Save button: status-bar message shown when Save is clicked before a target table name is entered, because each profile belongs to one target table.

profiles_label.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → profile controls: label to the left of the saved-import-profile selector and name input.

profiles_unavailable.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles row: notice under the profile controls shown when the saved import-profiles file cannot be read, so no profiles are listed. {error} is the technical reason.

proposed_columns.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → new-table settings: summary of the column names and inferred types proposed for the new table.

rejected_row_detail.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → type-mismatch warning: detail for one rejected row, including its row number, column, source value, and rejection reason.

rejected_rows_omitted.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → type-mismatch warning: final detail indicating how many rejected rows are omitted after the first five details.

rejected_rows_summary.value: {rejected_count} 行將因型別不符被拒絕：{details}
rejected_rows_summary.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → type-mismatch warning: plural summary introducing the rejected-row details when more than one row will be rejected.

rejected_rows_summary_one.value: {rejected_count} 行將因型別不符被拒絕：{details}
rejected_rows_summary_one.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → type-mismatch warning: singular summary introducing the rejected-row detail when exactly one row will be rejected.

row_cell_count_mismatch.value: 列 {row_number} 有 {cell_count} 個儲存格對應 {column_count} 個欄位
row_cell_count_mismatch.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error (also a status-bar error when opening a .sqllyexport file) shown when a row in a SQLLY Export file has more cells than it declares columns. {row_number} is 1-based; {cell_count} and {column_count} are counts.

script_as_label.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → script options: label to the left of the INSERT statements and BULK INSERT selector chips.

script_bulk_insert.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → script options: chip that selects a server-side BULK INSERT script for SQL Server with an existing target table.

script_import_button.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → footer: primary button that opens the reviewed import script in a new editor tab without executing it.

script_insert_statements.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → script options: chip that selects per-row or batched INSERT statements for review.

sheet_label.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → source options: label to the left of the worksheet selector for Excel imports.

sheet_read_failed.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red error shown when the selected sheet of an Excel workbook cannot be read. {sheet_name} is the sheet tab name; {error} is the technical detail.

sheet_row_limit.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red error shown when the selected Excel sheet has more than one million non-empty rows, the import limit.

source_metadata_all.value: {source} · 編碼：{encoding} · 取代字元 · {error_cell_count} 錯誤單元格讀取為 NULL
source_metadata_all.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Source line beside the file chooser: source label when the file’s encoding was detected, some characters could not be decoded and were replaced, and some Excel error cells were read as NULL. {source} is the path; {encoding} the encoding; {error_cell_count} a count.

source_metadata_encoding.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Source line beside the file chooser: source label for a text file whose character encoding was detected and decoded cleanly. {source} is the file path; {encoding} is the encoding name such as UTF-8.

source_metadata_encoding_lossy.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Source line beside the file chooser: source label for a text file whose encoding was detected but some bytes could not be decoded and were shown as replacement characters. {source} is the path; {encoding} the encoding name.

source_metadata_encoding_sheet_errors.value: {source} · 編碼：{encoding} · {error_cell_count} 錯誤單元格讀取為 NULL
source_metadata_encoding_sheet_errors.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Source line beside the file chooser: source label with a detected encoding plus a count of spreadsheet error cells (such as #DIV/0!) imported as NULL. {source} is the path; {encoding} the encoding; {error_cell_count} the count.

source_metadata_lossy.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Source line beside the file chooser: source label when no encoding name is shown but some characters could not be decoded and appear as replacement characters. {source} is the file path or clipboard label.

source_metadata_lossy_sheet_errors.value: {source} · 取代字元 · {error_cell_count} 錯誤單元格讀取為 NULL
source_metadata_lossy_sheet_errors.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Source line beside the file chooser: source label combining undecodable characters shown as replacements and a count of spreadsheet error cells imported as NULL. {source} is the path; {error_cell_count} the count.

source_metadata_plain.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Source line beside the file chooser: source label with no extra details, only the chosen file path or the “Clipboard (N lines)” label. {source} is that text; usually kept as is.

source_metadata_sheet_errors.value: {source} · {error_cell_count} 錯誤儲存格讀取為 NULL
source_metadata_sheet_errors.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Source line beside the file chooser: source label for an Excel workbook where some cells held spreadsheet errors (such as #N/A) that were imported as NULL. {source} is the path; {error_cell_count} the count.

sqlly_export_column_cap.value: SQLLY 匯出必須包含 1 到 {column_cap} 欄
sqlly_export_column_cap.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error (also a status-bar error when opening a .sqllyexport file) shown when a SQLLY Export file has no columns or more than the supported maximum. {column_cap} is that maximum.

sqlly_export_row_cap.value: SQLLY 匯出超過 {row_cap} 行的匯入限制
sqlly_export_row_cap.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error (also a status-bar error when opening a .sqllyexport file) shown when a SQLLY Export file has more rows than can be imported. {row_cap} is the row limit; “{row_cap}-row” is an adjective.

target_label.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → target controls: label to the left of the target schema and table inputs.

target_table_placeholder.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Target row: placeholder in the table-name input beside the schema input, naming the table to import into. Written as one identifier-like word with no space.

type_count_mismatch.value: 欄位類型有 {entry_count} 項目；檔案有 {column_count} 欄
type_count_mismatch.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Column types field: red validation error under the Column types input when its comma-separated list has a different number of entries than the file has columns. {entry_count} is entries typed; {column_count} is source columns.

types_placeholder.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Column types input: placeholder showing the comma-separated per-column type list, where “auto” keeps the detected type. Keep the type keywords (int, text, date, auto) untranslated; translate only “Optional”.

unknown_column_type.value: 未知欄位類型 '{type_name}' — 使用 text、int、decimal、bool、date、datetime、uuid 或 auto
unknown_column_type.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Column types field: red validation error when an entry is not a recognized type keyword. {type_name} is what the user typed; the listed keywords (text, int, decimal, bool, date, datetime, uuid, auto) must stay untranslated.

unsupported_source_engine.value: 不支援的 SQLLY 匯出來源引擎：{engine_name}
unsupported_source_engine.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error (also a status-bar error when opening a .sqllyexport file) shown when a SQLLY Export file names a source database engine SQLLY does not know. {engine_name} is that name.

unsupported_sqlly_export_version.value: 不支援的 SQLLY 匯出格式或版本
unsupported_sqlly_export_version.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error (also a status-bar error when opening a .sqllyexport file) shown when the file is not a SQLLY Export or uses a format version this SQLLY version cannot read.

workbook_no_sheets.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red error shown when the chosen Excel workbook contains no worksheets to import.

workbook_open_failed.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red error shown when the chosen Excel workbook (.xlsx, .xls) cannot be opened, for example because it is corrupt or password-protected. {error} is the technical detail.

default_label.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles dropdown: list entry for the profile marked as default for its table, which applies automatically. {profile_name} is the profile; {table_name} is its target table (schema.table); keep “(default)” short.

duplicate_name.value: 此表已存在名為 '{profile_name}' 的設定檔
duplicate_name.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Rename button: status-bar message shown when renaming a profile to a name another profile for the same target table already uses (case-insensitive). {profile_name} is the requested name.

label.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles dropdown: list entry for an ordinary (non-default) saved import profile. {profile_name} is the profile name; {table_name} is the target table it belongs to (schema.table).

name_required.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Rename button: status-bar message shown when Rename is clicked while the profile name input is empty.

no_longer_exists.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Rename button: status-bar message shown when the selected profile was removed from the profiles file (for example in another window) before it could be renamed.

save_blocked.value: {error}。匯入的設定檔未儲存 — 請先修正或移動該檔案
save_blocked.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Save, Rename, Delete, Default buttons: status-bar error when the existing import-profiles file is corrupt, so SQLLY refuses to overwrite it. {error} is the read error, ending the first sentence.

save_failed.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Save, Rename, Delete, Default buttons: status-bar error when writing the import-profiles file to disk fails. {file_path} is the file’s path; {error} is the operating-system error.

canvas_too_large.value: 忽略結果版面配置：畫布 {rows}x{columns} 超過最大 {maximum_rows}x{maximum_columns}。
canvas_too_large.location: SQL editor → Result layout comment: squiggle error on the first-line canvas comment (for example “-- sqlly 4x2”) when its grid is bigger than allowed, so the layout is ignored. {rows}x{columns} is the requested size; {maximum_rows}x{maximum_columns} is the limit.

control_label.location: Results → Result tab bar → Result layout control: label of the clickable control beside the Export link that toggles multiple result sets between stacked cards and one tab per result set.

dangling_placement.value: 結果版面配置 {placement} 後未跟隨可產生結果的語句。
dangling_placement.location: SQL editor → Result layout comment: squiggle warning on a “-- sqlly result:” placement comment not followed by any statement that returns rows, so it places nothing. {placement} is the comment’s row|column value.

hidden_problem_count.value: …以及 {hidden_count} 個更多版面配置問題。
hidden_problem_count.location: Results → Canvas layout: last note line under the canvas board when more than three runtime layout problems occurred, counting the ones not listed. {hidden_count} is that number; “problem(s)” covers singular and plural.

malformed_placement_ranges.value: 結果佈局位置 {placement} 格式錯誤；預期為正整數範圍。
malformed_placement_ranges.location: SQL editor → Result layout comment: squiggle warning on a “-- sqlly result:” placement whose row or column part is not a positive whole number or range like 1-2. {placement} is the value written; keep “row|column” wording consistent with sibling messages.

malformed_placement_separator.value: 結果佈局位置 {placement} 格式錯誤；預期為行|列。
malformed_placement_separator.location: SQL editor → Result layout comment: squiggle warning on a “-- sqlly result:” placement lacking exactly one “|” between its row and column parts. {placement} is the value written; keep the literal “row|column” as a syntax example.

no_open_cell_for_result.value: 結果佈局：結果集 {result_number} 沒有開啟的儲存格。
no_open_cell_for_result.location: Results → Canvas layout: note line under the canvas board shown after a run when a result set could not be placed because every cell of the board is already taken. {result_number} is the 1-based result set number.

no_open_cell_for_statement.value: 結果佈局對語句 {statement_number} 沒有開啟的儲存格。
no_open_cell_for_statement.location: SQL editor → Result layout comment: squiggle warning on a statement (or its placement comment) for which no free cell remains on the canvas board declared in the first-line comment. {statement_number} is the 1-based row-returning statement number.

nonpositive_canvas.value: 結果佈局被忽略：畫布尺寸必須為正值。
nonpositive_canvas.location: SQL editor → Result layout comment: squiggle error on the first-line canvas comment (for example “-- sqlly 4x2”) when the row or column count is zero, so the whole layout is ignored.

placement_outside_canvas.value: 結果佈局位置 {placement} 位於畫布 {rows}x{columns} 之外；改為自動放置該結果集。
placement_outside_canvas.location: SQL editor → Result layout comment: squiggle warning on a “-- sqlly result:” placement that falls outside the declared board, so that result is placed automatically. {placement} is the value; {rows}x{columns} is the board size.

placement_overlap.value: 結果佈局位置 {placement} 與 {conflicting_placement} 重疊；改為自動放置該結果集。
placement_overlap.location: SQL editor → Result layout comment: squiggle warning on a “-- sqlly result:” placement that overlaps an earlier placement, so that result is placed automatically. {placement} is this value; {conflicting_placement} is the earlier one.

reversed_placement_range.value: 結果佈局位置 {placement} 的範圍結束在其開始之前。
reversed_placement_range.location: SQL editor → Result layout comment: squiggle warning on a “-- sqlly result:” placement where a row or column range ends before it starts (for example 3-1). {placement} is the value written.

stacked_tooltip.value: 結果佈局：堆疊 — 點擊以便每個結果集有一個分頁
stacked_tooltip.location: Results → Result tab bar → Result layout control: tooltip shown while results are stacked as cards, saying a click switches to one tab per result set.

tabbed_tooltip.value: 結果佈局：分頁 — 點擊以堆疊它們
tabbed_tooltip.location: Results → Result tab bar → Result layout control: tooltip shown while each result set has its own tab, saying a click stacks them as cards in one scrolling view.

preparing_active_grid.location: Results → Results tab (tabbed layout): dim placeholder with a pulsing loader in the main grid area while the grid for the selected result set is still being built after its rows arrived.

preparing_canvas_grid.location: Results → Canvas layout → Board cell: dim centered placeholder inside one cell of the canvas board while that result set’s grid is still being built.

preparing_diff_grid.location: Results → Diff output tab → Run card: dim centered placeholder inside one of the two compared runs’ cards while that run’s grid is still being built.

preparing_stacked_grid.location: Results → Stacked layout → Result card: dim centered placeholder inside one stacked result-set card while its grid is still being built.

query_running.location: Results → Results tab: placeholder with a pulsing loader that covers the results area after a query starts and before its first result set arrives; usually followed by the elapsed time.

with_elapsed_time.location: Results → Results tab: loading placeholder text combined with a live timer while a query runs. {loading_message} is a status such as “Query running...”; {elapsed_time} is minutes:seconds like 0:07.

conditional_rule_not_serializable.value: {column_name} 上的條件規則包含分號，因此無法作為指令寫入。
conditional_rule_not_serializable.location: Results → Messages tab: note added after clicking the lock icon on a result tab when a conditional-formatting rule for {column_name} contains a semicolon and so could not be written into the query’s lock comment block.

filter_builder_not_locked.value: 篩選列… 超過每列篩選條件的篩選未被鎖定 — 使用「新增有效篩選到 WHERE」以將它們保留在查詢中。
filter_builder_not_locked.location: Results → Messages tab: note added after clicking the lock icon on a result tab while “Filter Rows…” conditions are active, explaining they are not saved in the lock and pointing to “Add Active Filters to WHERE”; keep those menu names matching.

locked_tooltip.value: 已鎖定：查詢會重現這些結果。點擊以將鎖定更新為您現在所看到的結果。
locked_tooltip.location: Results → Result tab → Lock icon before the result name: tooltip shown while the query already carries a lock block, explaining that clicking updates the lock to the grid’s current look.

unlocked_tooltip.value: 鎖定：將此網格的列、寬度、格式、樞紐分析和圖表寫入查詢，以便下一次執行完全與此相同。
unlocked_tooltip.location: Results → Result tab → Lock icon before the result name: tooltip shown while the query has no lock block, explaining that clicking writes the grid’s columns, widths, formatting, pivot, and chart into the query as comments.

unsafe_comment_line_omitted.value: 省略，因為它包含註解標記：{line}
unsafe_comment_line_omitted.location: Results → Messages tab: note added after clicking the lock icon when one directive line was left out of the lock block because it contains a comment marker that would end the block early. {line} is that directive line.

completed_with_elapsed_time.location: Results → Messages tab: final clock line after a run finishes. {timestamp} is the wall-clock time in brackets; {elapsed_ms} is the duration in milliseconds with digit grouping; keep “ms” as the unit abbreviation.

completed_without_elapsed_time.location: Results → Messages tab: final clock line after a run finishes when no duration was measured. {timestamp} is the wall-clock time in brackets.

database_context_changed.value: 已將資料庫上下文更改為 '{database_name}'。
database_context_changed.location: Results → Messages tab: line added when a statement in the run (such as USE) switches the session to another database. {database_name} is the new database.

diagnostic_line.location: Results → Messages tab: one line per pre-run validation finding about the SQL. {line_number} is the editor line after “L” (line); {severity} is a short tag such as ERROR or WARN; {diagnostic} is the message.

go_to_error_button.location: Results → Messages tab: small button in a bar at the top of the pane, shown when a failed run reports where the error is; clicking moves the editor cursor to the error’s position.

query_cancelled.location: Results → Messages tab: line added when the user cancels a running query before it finishes.

query_error.location: Results → Messages tab: line added when the server or driver reports that the query failed. {error} is the error text returned by the database.

query_started.location: Results → Messages tab: first line of a run’s messages, recording when it started. {timestamp} is the wall-clock time in brackets.

severity_confirmation.location: Results → Messages tab → Validation line: short uppercase severity tag for a finding that requires the user to confirm before the statement runs (for example a risky change); inserted as {severity} in the diagnostic line.

severity_error.location: Results → Messages tab → Validation line: short uppercase severity tag for an error-level validation finding, inserted as {severity} in the diagnostic line; keep it short and capitalized like a log level.

severity_info.location: Results → Messages tab → Validation line: short uppercase severity tag for an informational validation finding, inserted as {severity} in the diagnostic line; keep it short like a log level.

severity_warning.location: Results → Messages tab → Validation line: short uppercase severity tag (abbreviated “warning”) for a warning-level validation finding, inserted as {severity} in the diagnostic line; keep it short like a log level.

generated_heading.value: 由 SQLLY 從 {source} ({engine_name}) 產生
generated_heading.location: Object Explorer → Generate Model → Generated code tab: comment line written at the top of the generated model file; {source} is the qualified table name or a table count such as “3 tables”, {engine_name} the database engine name (e.g. PostgreSQL).

language_csharp.location: Object Explorer → Context menu → Generate Model submenus (per table, copy to clipboard, all tables): menu item that generates a C# record type from the table’s columns; “C#” is the language name and “record” the C# construct.

language_go.location: Object Explorer → Context menu → Generate Model submenus (per table, copy to clipboard, all tables): menu item that generates a Go struct from the table’s columns; “Go” is the programming language name, not the verb, and “struct” the Go construct.

language_java.location: Object Explorer → Context menu → Generate Model submenus (per table, copy to clipboard, all tables): menu item that generates a Java record type from the table’s columns; “record” is the Java language construct, not a database row.

language_kotlin.location: Object Explorer → Context menu → Generate Model submenus (per table, copy to clipboard, all tables): menu item that generates a Kotlin data class from the table’s columns; “data class” is the Kotlin construct name.

language_prisma.location: Object Explorer → Context menu → Generate Model submenus (per table, copy to clipboard, all tables): menu item that generates a Prisma schema model block from the table’s columns; Prisma is a product name and “model” its schema construct.

language_python.location: Object Explorer → Context menu → Generate Model submenus (per table, copy to clipboard, all tables): menu item that generates a Python dataclass from the table’s columns; “dataclass” is the Python construct name.

language_rust.location: Object Explorer → Context menu → Generate Model submenus (per table, copy to clipboard, all tables): menu item that generates a Rust struct from the table’s columns; “Rust” is the programming language name and “struct” its construct.

language_sqlalchemy.location: Object Explorer → Context menu → Generate Model submenus (per table, copy to clipboard, all tables): menu item that generates a SQLAlchemy ORM model class from the table’s columns; SQLAlchemy is a product name.

language_typescript.location: Object Explorer → Context menu → Generate Model submenus (per table, copy to clipboard, all tables): menu item that generates a TypeScript interface from the table’s columns; first entry in the language list.

language_zod.location: Object Explorer → Context menu → Generate Model submenus (per table, copy to clipboard, all tables): menu item that generates a Zod validation schema from the table’s columns; Zod is a TypeScript library name.

multiple_table_source.location: Object Explorer → Generate Models for All Tables → Generated code tab: phrase filling the source slot of the “Generated by SQLLY from …” header comment when one file holds several models; {table_count} is the number of tables.

change_explanation.value: 此命令可能會更改資料，因為它包含 {change_types}。
change_explanation.location: Query execution → Data-change confirmation dialog → Rule-based summary: sentence explaining why the batch can modify data; {change_types} is a comma-separated list of SQL verbs such as “UPDATE, DELETE”.

data_changes.location: Query execution → Data-change confirmation dialog → Bottom line: all-caps headline above the SQL preview when the batch changes data but no specific verb list applies; fallback for the per-verb variants.

multiple_change_types.value: 我們將進行 {leading_types} 及 {last_type} 的更改。
multiple_change_types.location: Query execution → Data-change confirmation dialog → Bottom line: all-caps headline when the batch contains three or more kinds of change; {leading_types} is a comma-separated list of SQL verbs, {last_type} the final verb (e.g. “UPDATE, DELETE, AND TRUNCATE”).

one_change_type.location: Query execution → Data-change confirmation dialog → Bottom line: all-caps headline when the batch contains exactly one kind of change; {change_type} is an untranslated SQL verb such as UPDATE or DELETE.

two_change_types.value: 我們將進行 {first_type} 與 {second_type} 變更。
two_change_types.location: Query execution → Data-change confirmation dialog → Bottom line: all-caps headline when the batch contains exactly two kinds of change; {first_type} and {second_type} are untranslated SQL verbs such as INSERT and UPDATE.

unbounded_warning.value: 潛在危險：至少有一個 UPDATE 或 DELETE 沒有 WHERE 子句，因此可能影響其目標表中的每一行。
unbounded_warning.location: Query execution → Data-change confirmation dialog → Rule-based summary: second line warning that an UPDATE or DELETE in the batch lacks a WHERE clause and could change every row of its table.

unknown_changes.value: 我們無法驗證此批次會改變什麼。
unknown_changes.location: Query execution → Data-change confirmation dialog → Bottom line: all-caps headline shown when the batch cannot be read reliably (for example an unterminated string or comment), so what it changes cannot be verified.

browser_downloaded.value: 已下載 {file_name} — 可從瀏覽器的下載資料夾中開啟
browser_downloaded.location: Results → Export menu → Open in Spreadsheet (browser version): success toast after the spreadsheet file is downloaded instead of opened; {file_name} is the downloaded file name; tells the user to open it from the browser’s downloads.

create_temp_error.location: Results → Export menu → Open in Spreadsheet: error toast, also added to the Messages tab, when the private temporary file for the export cannot be created; {error} is the operating-system error text.

empty_error.value: 試算表中沒有可開啟的內容。
empty_error.location: Results → Export menu → Open in Spreadsheet: error toast, also added to the Messages tab, when no spreadsheet content could be built from the active result (nothing to send to the spreadsheet app).

no_opener_error.value: 目前的作業系統沒有預設應用程式來開啟
no_opener_error.location: Results → Export menu → Open in Spreadsheet: lowercase error fragment shown in a toast and the Messages tab when the operating system has no supported command for opening a file in its default app.

open_error.location: Results → Export menu → Open in Spreadsheet: error toast, also added to the Messages tab, when launching the default spreadsheet app fails; {file_path} is the temporary export file, {error} the system error text.

opened_native.value: 已在預設試算表應用程式中開啟 {file_path}
opened_native.location: Results → Export menu → Open in Spreadsheet (desktop app): success toast after the export is written to a temporary file and handed to the OS default spreadsheet app; {file_path} is that temporary file’s path.

write_temp_error.location: Results → Export menu → Open in Spreadsheet: error toast, also added to the Messages tab, when writing the exported data into the temporary file fails; {file_path} is the file path, {error} the system error text.

ddl.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: tab label for the DDL view (CREATE script of an object), present only after an object’s definition has been opened; keep short, usually left as the abbreviation.

diff.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: tab label for the Diff view comparing the current run’s results with a retained earlier run; appears only when result difference tracking is on.

history.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: always-present tab label that shows the query execution history for this editor tab; noun, keep short.

messages.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: always-present tab label for server messages, errors and run notes; a small superscript count may follow it; noun, keep short.

plan.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: tab label for the execution plan view, placed next to Results and present only when the run asked for a query plan; noun, keep short.

preview_sql.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: tab label for the pending-changes script preview, present only while row edits are staged in the grid; “Preview” used as a noun/adjective, keep short.

results.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: first, always-present tab label that shows the query result grids; noun, keep short.

statistics.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: tab label for the Client Statistics view of the run (timings, rows, bytes), present only after statistics have been opened; noun, keep short.

tooltip_with_index.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: tooltip on an output tab when no custom shortcut is bound, showing the built-in numbered shortcut; {tab_name} is the tab label, {shortcut} the digit (1–6) pressed with Cmd.

tooltip_with_shortcut.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: tooltip on an output tab when its select-tab command has a key binding; {tab_name} is the tab label, {shortcut} the full key combination text such as “⌘2”.

detach_results_tooltip.location: Results pane → Header layout buttons: tooltip on the frame-icon button that moves the results out of the editor into their own separate window.

maximize_results_tooltip.location: Results pane → Header layout buttons: tooltip on the up-chevron button that enlarges the results to fill the area, hiding the SQL editor above.

restore_editor_tooltip.location: Results pane → Header layout buttons: tooltip on the down-chevron button, shown while results are maximized, that brings the SQL editor back above the results.

clipboard_empty.value: 剪貼簿沒有可貼上的文字
clipboard_empty.location: Results → Editable grid → Paste: line added to the Messages tab when the user pastes into the grid but the clipboard contains no text.

extra_columns_dropped.value: 貼上被拖放的 {column_count} 額外欄位超出資料表
extra_columns_dropped.location: Results → Editable grid → Paste: line added to the Messages tab when pasted data is wider than the table and the extra columns are ignored; {column_count} is the number of dropped columns.

row_value_error.location: Results → Editable grid → Paste: line added to the Messages tab for each pasted cell that could not be staged; {row_number} is the pasted row, {column_name} the column, {error} the reason, {cell_text} the quoted pasted text.

value_required.value: 此值為必填（欄位不可為 NULL）
value_required.location: Results → Editable grid → Paste rows: lowercase reason text inserted into the paste error line when a pasted cell is empty but its column does not allow NULL.

column_cap_warning.value: 樞軸提示：樞軸欄位上限 {column_cap} 已超過；目前僅顯示前 {column_cap} 個欄位。
column_cap_warning.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot warnings: warning that the pivot has more distinct column keys than the limit, so only the first {column_cap} columns are kept; {column_cap} is the limit (250).

column_index_not_allowed.value: 樞紐提示被忽略：{field_role} 必須命名為結果欄位，而不能使用欄位索引。
column_index_not_allowed.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because a field gave a column number or empty name; {field_role} is the untranslated field keyword (row, column, value or format).

duplicate_axis_columns.value: 樞紐提示被忽略：列、欄和數值必須引用三個不同的欄位。
duplicate_axis_columns.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because its row, column and value fields do not name three distinct result columns.

format_options_missing.value: 樞紐提示被忽略：缺少格式選項（預期 key=value 配對或 "default"）。
format_options_missing.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because a format or valueformat field has nothing after the colon; key=value and “default” are literal syntax, keep them untranslated.

invalid_alignment.value: 樞紐提示被忽略：對齊必須為左、中或右，而非 "{value}"。
invalid_alignment.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because the align format option is not left, center or right (literal keywords); {value} is what was typed.

invalid_boolean_option.value: 樞紐提示被忽略：{option_name} 必須為 true 或 false，而非 "{value}"。
invalid_boolean_option.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because a yes/no format option is not true or false (literal keywords); {option_name} is red, parens or thousands, {value} the typed text.

invalid_decimals.value: 樞紐提示被忽略：小數位數必須為非負整數，而非 "{value}"。
invalid_decimals.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because the decimals format option is not a whole number of zero or more; {value} is what was typed.

invalid_result_number.value: 樞紐提示被忽略：結果必須是從 1 開始的結果集編號，而非 "{value}"。
invalid_result_number.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because the result field is not a result-set number starting at 1; {value} is what was typed.

malformed_field.value: 樞紐提示被忽略：欄位 "{field}" 格式錯誤（預期 key:value）。
malformed_field.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because a semicolon-separated segment has no colon; {field} is that segment; key:value is literal syntax.

malformed_format_field.value: 樞軸提示被忽略：格式欄位必須是 format:<column>:<options>。
malformed_format_field.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because a format field lacks its second colon; the syntax format:<column>:<options> is literal, translate only the placeholders’ words if at all.

malformed_format_option.value: 樞軸提示被忽略：格式選項 "{option}" 格式錯誤（預期為 key=value）。
malformed_format_option.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because one comma-separated format option has no equals sign; {option} is that option text; key=value is literal syntax.

malformed_value_field.value: 樞軸提示被忽略：數值欄位必須是 value:<column>:<aggregate>。
malformed_value_field.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because the value field does not name both a column and an aggregate; value:<column>:<aggregate> is literal syntax.

missing_column.value: 樞軸提示被忽略：{field_role} 欄位 "{column_name}" 未在結果集中找到。
missing_column.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because a named column is not in the result; {field_role} is the untranslated field keyword (row, column or value), {column_name} the missing name.

multiple_hints.value: 樞軸提示：找到多個 -- sqlly pivot: 提示；使用最後一個有效提示。
multiple_hints.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot warnings: warning that the query has more than one valid pivot directive and only the last one is used; “-- sqlly pivot:” is literal syntax.

null_key_warning.value: 樞軸提示：在列/欄鍵位置發現空值；這些表示為 '{null_placeholder}'。
null_key_warning.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot warnings: warning that some row or column key values are NULL and are shown under a placeholder label; {null_placeholder} is that literal label.

required_field_missing.value: 樞軸提示被忽略：缺少必填欄位 "{field_role}"。
required_field_missing.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because a mandatory field is absent; {field_role} is the untranslated field keyword (row, column or value).

unknown_field.value: 樞軸提示被忽略：未知欄位 "{field_name}"。
unknown_field.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because a segment uses a field keyword the parser does not know; {field_name} is that keyword as typed.

unknown_format_option.value: 樞軸提示被忽略：未知的格式選項 "{option_name}"。
unknown_format_option.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because a format option name is not align, decimals, red, parens or thousands; {option_name} is the unrecognized name.

unsupported_aggregate.value: 樞軸提示被忽略：不支援的值彙總 "{aggregate}"。
unsupported_aggregate.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly pivot:” comment directive → Pivot errors: the hint is ignored because the value field’s aggregate is not count, sum, avg, first, max or min; {aggregate} is the typed name.

view_without_hint.value: 要求樞軸檢視，但未找到 -- sqlly pivot: 提示。
view_without_hint.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly view: pivot” directive → Pivot warnings: warning that the query asked to open the Pivot view but contains no “-- sqlly pivot:” directive describing it; directive text is literal.

loading_locked.location: Results → Grid tab bar → Pivot and Chart tabs: short status shown in parentheses after the disabled Pivot and Chart tab labels while the query is still running; keep very short.

result_too_large_locked.location: Results → Grid tab bar → Pivot and Chart tabs: short status shown in parentheses after the disabled Pivot and Chart tab labels when the result was spilled to disk and is too large to pivot or chart; keep very short.

copy_button.location: Results pane → Preview SQL tab → Toolbar: small button at the top right that copies the generated change script for the staged row edits; “Copy as SQL” is an action label.

copy_tooltip.value: 將待處理的變更腳本複製到剪貼簿
copy_tooltip.location: Results pane → Preview SQL tab → Toolbar: tooltip on the Copy as SQL button explaining that it puts the pending change script on the clipboard.

empty_state.value: 在此階段列編輯以預覽批次 SQL。
empty_state.location: Results pane → Preview SQL tab: centered empty-state hint shown when no row edits are staged yet, telling the user to stage edits so their batch SQL appears here.

all_columns_complete_caption.location: Results → Profile tab → Header: caption after Profile All Columns finishes on the whole result; {result_label} is the result set name (e.g. “Results 1”), {profiled_rows} the number of rows read.

all_columns_reading.value: 正在分析所有欄位 — 從磁碟讀取 {row_count} 列…
all_columns_reading.location: Results → Grid caption: progress status while Profile All Columns first reads a large disk-backed result into memory; {row_count} is the number of rows being read; ends with an ellipsis.

all_columns_truncated_caption.value: {result_label} — 已分析前 {profiled_rows} 列（結果過大）
all_columns_truncated_caption.location: Results → Profile tab → Header: caption after Profile All Columns when the result exceeded the row limit and only the first rows were analyzed; {result_label} is the result set name, {profiled_rows} the rows read.

binary_value.location: Results → Profile tab and profile Markdown: placeholder shown instead of a binary cell value in frequent-value lists; {byte_count} is the size of the value in bytes; angle brackets mark it as not literal data.

detail_distinct_count.location: Results → Profile tab → Column detail line: statistic fragment giving the exact number of distinct non-null values; {distinct_count} is that number; joined to other fragments with “·”.

detail_distinct_truncated.location: Results → Profile tab → Column detail line: statistic fragment used when distinct counting hit its cap, so the true count is at least {distinct_count}; joined to other fragments with “·”.

detail_fixed_text_length.location: Results → Profile tab → Column detail line: statistic fragment for text columns whose values all have the same length; {length} is that character count.

detail_null_count.location: Results → Profile tab → Column detail line: statistic fragment giving how many profiled values are NULL; {null_count} is the count, {null_percent} the share of rows with one decimal.

detail_numeric_maximum.location: Results → Profile tab → Column detail line: short statistic fragment for numeric columns giving the largest value; {value} is the number; abbreviation of maximum.

detail_numeric_mean.location: Results → Profile tab → Column detail line: short statistic fragment for numeric columns giving the arithmetic average; {value} is the number.

detail_numeric_minimum.location: Results → Profile tab → Column detail line: short statistic fragment for numeric columns giving the smallest value; {value} is the number; abbreviation of minimum.

detail_row_count.location: Results → Profile tab → Column detail line: first statistic fragment giving how many rows were profiled for the selected column; {row_count} is that number.

detail_text_length_range.location: Results → Profile tab → Column detail line: statistic fragment for text columns giving shortest to longest value length; {minimum} and {maximum} are character counts joined by an en dash.

filter_all_columns.location: Results → Profile tab → Filter chips: first chip label, followed by “· count”, that shows every profiled column (removes the filter).

filter_constant.location: Results → Profile tab → Filter chips: chip label, followed by “· count”, that keeps only columns holding at most one distinct value.

filter_low_cardinality.location: Results → Profile tab → Filter chips: chip label, followed by “· count”, that keeps columns with few distinct values (up to 20) that repeat across rows.

filter_mostly_null.location: Results → Profile tab → Filter chips: chip label, followed by “· count”, that keeps only columns where at least half the profiled values are NULL.

filter_numeric.location: Results → Profile tab → Filter chips: chip label, followed by “· count”, that keeps only columns with numeric values (those with min, max and mean).

filter_unique.location: Results → Profile tab → Filter chips: chip label, followed by “· count”, that keeps only columns with no NULLs where every value is different (candidate keys).

filter_with_nulls.location: Results → Profile tab → Filter chips: chip label, followed by “· count”, that keeps only columns containing at least one NULL value.

grid_column_name.location: Results → Profile tab → Profile grid: first column header, holding the name of each profiled result column.

grid_distinct.location: Results → Profile tab → Profile grid: column header for the number of distinct non-null values in each profiled column.

grid_length.location: Results → Profile tab → Profile grid: column header for the text length, or length range, of each column’s values in characters.

grid_maximum.location: Results → Profile tab → Profile grid: column header for the largest numeric value in each profiled column; the English “Grid maximum” is awkward, a short “Max”-style header is intended.

grid_mean.location: Results → Profile tab → Profile grid: column header for the arithmetic average of each numeric profiled column.

grid_minimum.location: Results → Profile tab → Profile grid: column header for the smallest numeric value in each profiled column; the English “Grid minimum” is awkward, a short “Min”-style header is intended.

grid_null_percent.location: Results → Profile tab → Profile grid: narrow column header for the percentage of each column’s values that are NULL; keep the percent sign.

grid_nulls.location: Results → Profile tab → Profile grid: column header for the count of NULL values in each profiled column.

grid_rows.location: Results → Profile tab → Profile grid: column header for the number of rows profiled for each column.

grid_top_values.location: Results → Profile tab → Profile grid: last column header, listing a short preview of each column’s most frequent values with their counts.

grid_type.location: Results → Profile tab → Profile grid: column header for the database data type of each profiled column.

markdown_column_header.location: Results → Grid column header menu → Copy Column Profile as Markdown: Markdown table header row copied to the clipboard (Column, Type, Nulls, Distinct, Min, Max, Mean, Length, Frequent values); translate the words only and keep the pipe and dash table syntax and blank lines exactly.

markdown_heading.value:
# 結果概況

已分析的行數：{row_count}
markdown_heading.location: Results → Grid column header menu → Copy Column Profile as Markdown: Markdown title and first line of the copied profile; keep the leading “# ” heading marker and the blank line; {row_count} is the number of rows profiled.

markdown_truncation.location: Results → Grid column header menu → Copy Column Profile as Markdown: fragment appended right after the rows-profiled count when the result was larger than the limit; {maximum_rows} is the row limit; starts with a space.

no_repeated_values.value: 分析的行中沒有重複值。
no_repeated_values.location: Results → Profile tab → Column detail: dimmed note in place of the frequent-values list when no value in the selected column occurs more than once.

query_section_label.location: Results → Profile tab → Query section: small caption above the syntax-colored SQL that produced the profiled result; noun.

select_column_detail_prompt.value: 選擇上方的欄位以檢視其完整概況 — 每個保留的常見值及其計數和占比。
select_column_detail_prompt.location: Results → Profile tab → Column detail: dimmed prompt below the profile grid when no row is selected, telling the user to pick a column to see all its frequent values with counts and percentages.

single_column_complete_caption.location: Results → Profile tab → Header: caption after Profile Column finishes on the whole result; {result_label} is the result set name, {column_name} the column, {profiled_rows} the rows read.

single_column_reading.value: 正在分析 {column_name} — 從磁碟讀取 {row_count} 行…
single_column_reading.location: Results → Grid caption: progress status while Profile Column first reads a large disk-backed result into memory; {column_name} is the column, {row_count} the rows being read; ends with an ellipsis.

single_column_truncated_caption.value: {result_label} · {column_name} — 已分析前 {profiled_rows} 行（結果更大）
single_column_truncated_caption.location: Results → Profile tab → Header: caption after Profile Column when only the first rows of a larger result were analyzed; {result_label} is the result set name, {column_name} the column, {profiled_rows} the rows read.

tab_label.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: label of the Profile tab that appears after Profile Column or Profile All Columns is used; noun meaning “data profile”, keep short.

tab_tooltip.location: Results pane → Output tab bar: tooltip on hover over the Profile tab, which switches to the column profile view for the current run.

comment_out.location: Results → Result set name → Right-click menu: menu item that comments out, in the SQL editor, the statement that produced this result set so it no longer runs.

open_settings.location: Results → Result set name → Right-click menu: last menu item, below a separator, that opens the Result Settings dialog for this result set; ellipsis signals a dialog.

set_visible_rows.location: Results → Result set name → Right-click menu: menu item that saves the currently visible row count as this result’s height in the query; {visible_rows} is that row count.

show_by_default.location: Results → Result set name → Right-click menu: checkable menu item that makes this result set the one shown first when the query runs; checked and disabled when it already is.

duplicate_name_error.value: 結果集名稱必須唯一 — 「{result_name}」同時被結果集 {first_result_number} 和結果集 {second_result_number} 使用。
duplicate_name_error.location: Query editor → “-- sqlly name” result directives: error when two result sets are given the same name; {result_name} is the repeated name, {first_result_number} and {second_result_number} the 1-based result set numbers.

default_label.location: Results → Result set header and profile captions: default name for a result set that has no name directive; {result_number} is its 1-based position in the run (e.g. “Results 2”).

cancel_button.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: footer button that closes the dialog without changing the result’s name, default-tab choice or visible row count.

comment_out_button.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: button on the left of the footer that closes the dialog and comments out, in the query editor, the statement that produced this result so it no longer runs.

comment_out_tooltip.value: 註解產生此結果的語句，讓它不再執行
comment_out_tooltip.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: tooltip on the “Comment Out Result” footer button explaining that it comments out the producing statement in the editor so that statement is skipped on the next run.

dialog_title.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: dialog title, opened from the pencil beside a result’s name or the name’s right-click menu; {result_number} is the 1-based number of the result set being configured (Results 1, Results 2…).

empty_statement_error.value: 結果 {result_number} 的語句沒有可註解的程式碼。
empty_statement_error.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown after “Comment Out Result” in the Result Settings dialog when the statement that produced the result contains no code to comment out; {result_number} is the result set’s 1-based number.

invalid_row_count.value: 行數必須是從 1 到 {maximum_rows} 的整數。
invalid_row_count.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: inline error under the fields shown on Save when the “Visible rows” field is not a whole number in range; {maximum_rows} is the largest allowed row count.

name_label.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: label above the text field where the user renames the result set; the name becomes the result’s tab or panel caption.

no_result_editing.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: fallback error shown if Save runs after the dialog has already gone away, meaning there is no result set whose settings are being edited.

save_button.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: primary footer button that writes the edited name, default-tab choice and visible row count into the query as result directives and closes the dialog.

show_by_default.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: checkbox label; when checked, this result set is the one shown first when the query’s results arrive.

show_by_default_hint.value: 當結果到達時，在分頁佈局中選擇其標籤，並在堆疊佈局中將其捲動到可見範圍。
show_by_default_hint.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: small help text under the “Show this result by default” checkbox explaining its effect in the tabbed results layout (selects the tab) and the stacked layout (scrolls to it).

unknown_statement_error.value: 無法判斷哪個語句產生了結果 {result_number} — 請手動將其註解。
unknown_statement_error.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown after “Comment Out Result” in the Result Settings dialog when SQLLY cannot map the result back to its statement in the editor; {result_number} is the result’s 1-based number; tells the user to edit the SQL manually.

visible_rows_hint.value: 堆疊面板顯示的行數，1–{maximum_rows}；清空此欄位以取消該設定。
visible_rows_hint.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: help text under the visible-rows number field; {maximum_rows} is the largest allowed value, and leaving the field empty removes the saved row-count setting.

visible_rows_label.location: Results → Result Settings dialog: label above the number field that sets how many grid rows this result’s panel is tall when results are shown in the stacked (one-under-another) layout.

aggregate_rows.value: 聚合行沒有可編輯的鍵
aggregate_rows.location: Results → Grid → Row-header Edit pencil: lowercase reason fragment explaining why rows cannot be edited when the SELECT returns only aggregate values (COUNT, SUM…), so there is no key to locate a source row; the pencil is hidden.

historical_results.value: 還原的歷史結果不能編輯
historical_results.location: Results → Grid → Row-header Edit pencil: lowercase reason fragment explaining why rows cannot be edited when the grid shows results restored from query history rather than a live run; the pencil is hidden.

later_result_set.value: 一個批次中只有第一個結果集可以編輯
later_result_set.location: Results → Grid → Row-header Edit pencil: lowercase reason fragment explaining why rows of the second or later result set of a multi-statement batch cannot be edited; only the first result set supports editing.

missing_query.value: 這些結果沒有關聯的查詢
missing_query.location: Results → Grid → Row-header Edit pencil: lowercase reason fragment explaining why rows cannot be edited when the results have no SQL text recorded with them to trace them back to a table.

not_single_table_select.value: 只有簡單的單表 SELECT 可以被編輯
not_single_table_select.location: Results → Grid → Row-header Edit pencil: lowercase reason fragment explaining why rows cannot be edited when the query is not a plain SELECT from one table (joins, subqueries or non-SELECT statements).

batch_insert_title.location: Results → Row editor dialog: dialog title (action name) used when the row editor is opened for the Batch Insert action from the results grid’s row context menu.

binary_byte_count.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: read-only placeholder shown in place of a binary column’s value, which cannot be typed; {byte_count} is the size of the value in bytes. Keep the angle brackets.

binary_load_required.value: 使用從檔案載入編輯二進位值…
binary_load_required.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a binary column’s field telling the user that binary values must be replaced with the “Load from file…” button rather than typed; lowercase fragment.

boolean_required.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a boolean column’s field when the typed value is not one of true, false, 1 or 0; lowercase instruction fragment; keep the literal words true and false.

check_constraint_violation.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a field whose value breaks a table CHECK constraint, detected locally before saving or reported by the server; {constraint_name} is the constraint’s name; lowercase fragment.

confirm_delete.value: 要從 {table_name} 刪除此列嗎？點擊確認刪除以繼續。
confirm_delete.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: confirmation prompt shown after the first click on Delete for a row with no child tables; {table_name} is the table; the user clicks the button now labeled “Confirm Delete” to actually delete.

confirm_delete_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Footer buttons: the Delete button’s label after its first click, turned red; a second click permanently deletes the row from the database.

confirm_delete_with_children.value: 要從 {table_name} 刪除此列嗎？此列被 {referencing_tables} 參考；如果存在子列，刪除將失敗。點擊確認刪除以繼續。
confirm_delete_with_children.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: confirmation prompt after the first Delete click when other tables reference this table by foreign key; {table_name} is the table, {referencing_tables} a comma-separated list of referencing tables.

confirm_insert.value: 此連線確認資料更改。正在向 {table_name} 插入一列 — 點擊確認插入以繼續。
confirm_insert.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: prompt shown on the first Insert click when the connection’s safety settings require confirming data changes; {table_name} is the target table; a second click on “Confirm Insert” inserts the row.

confirm_insert_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Footer buttons: label the primary Insert button switches to after a first click on a connection that requires confirming data changes; clicking it again performs the insert.

confirm_update.value: 此連線確認資料變更。正在更新 {table_name} 中一列的 {change_count} 欄位 — 點擊確認更新以繼續。
confirm_update.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: prompt shown on the first Save click when the connection requires confirming data changes; {change_count} is the number of changed columns (plural form), {table_name} is the table.

confirm_update_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Footer buttons: label the primary Save button switches to after a first click on a connection that requires confirming data changes; clicking it again writes the update to the row.

confirm_update_one.value: 此連線確認資料變更。正在更新 {table_name} 中一列的 {change_count} 欄位 — 點擊確認更新以繼續。
confirm_update_one.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: singular variant of the update confirmation prompt used when exactly one column changed; {change_count} is 1 and {table_name} is the table; a second click on “Confirm Update” saves.

date_required.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a date column’s field when the text is not a valid date; the example shows the expected year-month-day format; lowercase instruction fragment, keep the example date unchanged.

datetime_required.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a date-and-time column’s field when the text is not a valid timestamp; the example shows the expected format; lowercase fragment, keep the example unchanged.

default_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Field action buttons: small button beside a field that has a column default; sets the value to the column’s DEFAULT so the database fills it on save.

delete_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Footer buttons: button that starts deleting the edited row from the database; the first click asks for confirmation in the message banner, shown only when editing an existing row.

delete_conflict_refresh.value: 此列自載入後伺服器已有變更；未刪除任何資料。請刷新後再試。
delete_conflict_refresh.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: error shown when Delete is refused because the row was changed on the server after the editor loaded it; nothing was deleted, and the user should click Refresh Row and retry.

delete_without_primary_key.value: 此列沒有主鍵，無法安全刪除。
delete_without_primary_key.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: error shown when Delete is clicked but the row has no primary-key values to identify it, so it cannot be deleted without risking other rows.

detached_edit_title.location: Row editor pop-out window → Title bar: operating-system window title shown after the row editor dialog is popped out into its own separate, resizable window.

duplicate_title.location: Results → Row editor dialog: dialog title (action name) when the editor opens a new-row form prefilled with a copy of the clicked row, from the results grid’s Duplicate Row action.

duplicate_without_key_title.location: Results → Row editor dialog: dialog title (action name) when duplicating the clicked row with its primary-key columns emptied so the copy can be inserted without a key collision.

edit_title.location: Results → Row editor dialog: dialog title (action name) while editing an existing row opened from the grid’s row-header pencil or Edit Row action; later combined with the table name.

field_change_count.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Row values heading: summary at the right of the heading when two or more fields were changed; {column_count} is the number of columns, {change_count} the number of changed fields (plural).

field_change_count_one.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Row values heading: singular summary at the right of the heading when exactly one field was changed; {column_count} is the number of columns and {change_count} is 1.

field_count.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Row values heading: summary at the right of the heading when no fields have been changed yet; {column_count} is the number of columns in the row.

fix_highlighted_fields.value: 在儲存前修正標示的欄位。
fix_highlighted_fields.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: error shown when Save is clicked while one or more fields fail validation; those fields show their own red messages below them.

fk_matches_truncated.value: 顯示第一批符合結果 — 精確篩選以縮小範圍。
fk_matches_truncated.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Foreign-key lookup dropdown: note at the bottom of the suggestion list for a foreign-key field when more rows match than are shown; asks the user to type more to narrow the results.

fk_no_matches.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Foreign-key lookup dropdown: empty-state message in the suggestion list of a foreign-key field when the search for the typed text finds no row in the referenced table.

fk_searching.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Foreign-key lookup dropdown: progress text in the suggestion list of a foreign-key field while the referenced table is being searched for the typed text.

foreign_key_no_match.value: 在 {referenced_table} 中沒有符合的列
foreign_key_no_match.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a foreign-key field when the server rejects the save because the entered value has no matching row in the referenced table; {referenced_table} is that table; lowercase fragment.

foreign_key_selected_label.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: small chip beside a foreign-key field naming the referenced row the user picked from the lookup; {label} is that row’s display text. Keep the arrow.

guid_required.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a GUID/UUID column’s field when the text is not a valid GUID; the example shows the expected format; lowercase fragment, keep the example unchanged.

insert_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Field action buttons: small dropdown button beside a field offering generated values (New UUID, server SQL functions); opens a menu, it does not insert a row. Verb meaning “insert a value”.

insert_generated_relay_blocked_tooltip.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Field action buttons: tooltip on a field’s value-generator “Insert” dropdown when some SQL functions are disabled on a relay connection; {reason} is an appended sentence explaining why.

insert_generated_tooltip.value: 插入產生的值或 SQL 函式
insert_generated_tooltip.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Field action buttons: tooltip on a field’s value-generator “Insert” dropdown explaining it fills the field with a generated value such as a new UUID or a SQL function.

insert_save_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Footer buttons: primary button on a new-row form (Insert Row, Duplicate Row) that inserts the row into the table immediately; verb, not a menu.

insert_title.location: Results → Row editor dialog: dialog title (action name) when the editor opens a blank form to insert a brand-new row into the result’s table; later combined with the table name.

integer_out_of_range.value: 必須介於 {minimum} 和 {maximum} 之間
integer_out_of_range.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under an integer column’s field when the number is outside the column type’s range; {minimum} and {maximum} are the allowed limits; lowercase fragment.

load_file_browser_unavailable.value: 從檔案載入在此版本中不可用。
load_file_browser_unavailable.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: error shown in the browser (web) edition when “Load from file…” is clicked on a binary field, because reading local files is not supported there.

load_file_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Field action buttons: small button beside a binary column’s field that opens a file picker and replaces the value with the chosen file’s bytes.

loading_row.value: 正在解析表並載入當前列…
loading_row.location: Results → Row editor dialog: progress text in the dialog body right after opening, while SQLLY identifies the source table and fetches the row’s current values from the server.

new_uuid_menu_item.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Field action buttons → Insert dropdown menu: menu item that fills the field with a freshly generated random UUID.

no_changes_to_save.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Message banner: info message shown when Save is clicked but no field differs from the loaded row, or the server reports nothing changed.

no_related_rows.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Related rows panel: empty-state text under an expanded referencing table when no child rows point at the edited row.

not_editable_explanation.location: Results → Row editor dialog: sentence lead-in in the dialog body when the row cannot be edited; the specific reason appears on the next line. Ends with a colon.

not_editable_title.location: Results → Row editor dialog: dialog title shown instead of the action name when the server check finds the clicked row cannot be edited (for example no primary key or row deleted).

not_nullable.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: short word under a column name, after its data type, meaning the column does not accept NULL; lowercase, fills {nullability} in the type summary.

now_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list → Field action buttons: small button beside a time or date-time field that fills it with this computer’s current local time (plus today’s date for date-time columns).

null_not_allowed.value: 此值為必填（欄位不可為 NULL）
null_not_allowed.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a field the user set to NULL although the column is NOT NULL (shown when editing an existing row); lowercase fragment, keep “NOT NULL”.

nullable.location: Results → Row Editor → field metadata: lowercase nullability suffix in the data-type summary for a nullable field.

numeric_required.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: inline error under a decimal, numeric or floating-point column’s field when the text is empty or not a number; lowercase instruction fragment.

open_related_query.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Related rows panel: small button in a referencing table’s heading that opens a new query tab with the SELECT listing all of that table’s rows related to this row.

read_only_computed.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: small badge beside a column name marking it read-only because the database computes its value; one lowercase word.

read_only_identity.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: small badge beside a column name marking it read-only because it is an auto-incrementing identity column; one lowercase word, the database term.

read_only_primary_key.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: small badge beside a column name marking it read-only while editing an existing row because it is part of the primary key that locates the row.

read_only_rowversion.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: small badge beside a column name marking it read-only because it is a SQL Server rowversion (timestamp) column; database type name, usually left untranslated.

read_only_spatial.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: small badge beside a geometry or geography column’s name explaining the spatial value can be viewed but not edited here.

read_only_unsupported_type.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Field list: small badge beside a column name marking it read-only because the editor does not support its data type; short lowercase fragment.

refresh_button.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Footer buttons: button that reloads the edited row’s current values from the server, replacing the form; shown only when editing an existing row.

related_loading.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Related rows panel: progress text under an expanded referencing table while its child rows are being fetched.

related_null_key.value: 此列的參照鍵為 NULL；它沒有子列。
related_null_key.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Related rows panel: note under a referencing table explaining no children can exist because this row’s referenced key column is NULL.

related_rows_title.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Related rows panel: heading of the lower panel listing tables whose foreign keys point at the edited row; shown only when such tables exist.

related_table_heading.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Related rows panel: heading of one referencing table entry, clicked to expand its rows; {table_name} is the child table and {constraint_name} the foreign-key constraint linking it.

related_truncated.value: 顯示前 {row_count} 列 — 使用「開啟查詢」檢視全部。
related_truncated.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Related rows panel: note under a referencing table’s child rows when only part of them is shown; {row_count} is how many are shown; points to the Open query button for the full list.

relationship_count.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Related rows panel: count beside the Related rows heading when two or more tables reference this row; {relationship_count} is the number of referencing relationships (plural).

relationship_count_one.location: Results → Row editor dialog → Related rows panel: singular count beside the Related rows heading when exactly one table references this row; {relationship_count} is 1.
