alias_as_keyword.value: 包含 AS 關鍵字（Orders AS o，而不是 Orders o）
alias_as_keyword.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → When you accept a table or view: checkbox that writes the SQL keyword AS between table and alias; AS and the examples stay unchanged.

alias_include_schema.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Alias names: indented checkbox under the capital-letters option that also adds the schema's initial to the alias (Shared.PaymentMethod gets spm).

auto_insert_connectors.value: WHERE / JOIN ON 連線詞（插入遺漏的 AND）
auto_insert_connectors.location: Settings → Editor → General → Automagic commas: checkbox that inserts a missing AND between conditions in WHERE and JOIN … ON clauses; SQL keywords stay in English.

auto_spacing.location: Settings → Editor → General → Spacing: the only checkbox under the Spacing heading, turning automatic spacing of typed SQL on or off; on by default.

built_function_names.location: Settings → Editor → General → Bold text: checkbox in the list of word kinds; when ticked, names of the database's built-in functions (such as COUNT or GETDATE) are drawn in bold.

camel_hump_word_movement.location: Settings → Editor → General → Navigation: checkbox that makes word-by-word caret movement stop at each capital letter inside a CamelCase name (for example Order|Date).

date_like_column_names.value: 將像日期的欄位視為日期
date_like_column_names.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: checkbox that treats columns whose names look like dates as date columns when their type is unknown, so plain-word dates work after them.

feedback_full_model_default.value: 預設在 IntelliSense 回饋中包含完整資料模型
feedback_full_model_default.location: Settings → Editor → General → IntelliSense: checkbox that makes the Improve IntelliSense feedback dialog start with “Include all” ticked, sending the whole data model's object names with each report.

frame_current_statement.location: Settings → Editor → General → Display: checkbox that draws a thin frame around the SQL statement the caret is currently in; “frame” is a verb meaning outline.

functions.location: Settings → Editor → General → Feedback report object kinds: checkbox that makes the Improve IntelliSense dialog list functions by default.

group_by_lists.location: Settings → Editor → General → Automagic commas: checkbox that enables automatic comma insertion between items of a GROUP BY list; GROUP BY is a SQL keyword and stays in English.

highlight_selection_occurrences.location: Settings → Editor → General → Selection: checkbox that softly highlights every other occurrence of the currently selected word or phrase in the script.

detect_query_placeholders.value: 詢問 :name、? 和 $1 佔位符的值
detect_query_placeholders.location: Settings → Editor → General → Query parameters: checkbox that makes :name, ? and $1 placeholders in a query ask for values in the Parameters strip before Run.

hover_info.value: 顯示資料表、欄位和例程的懸停資訊
hover_info.location: Settings → Editor → General → Display: checkbox that turns on the info cards shown when the mouse hovers over table, column, procedure or function names in the editor.

include_schema_name_searching.value: 在搜尋中包含架構名稱
include_schema_name_searching.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Matching: checkbox that makes completion search the schema name together with the object name (so typing dboM finds dbo.Make).

individual_columns.location: Settings → Editor → General → Feedback report object kinds: checkbox that makes the Improve IntelliSense dialog list columns as separate pickable items by default.

insert_column_hints.value: 在 INSERT 值中顯示欄位提示
insert_column_hints.location: Settings → Editor → General → Display: checkbox that paints dim column-name labels before each value in an INSERT … VALUES list so you can see which column each value fills.

keep_typed_date_comment.value: 將我輸入的內容儲存在 --sqlly date: 評語中
keep_typed_date_comment.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: checkbox that keeps the typed words in a “--sqlly date:” comment next to the inserted date; the comment marker stays unchanged.

keywords.location: Settings → Editor → General → Bold text: checkbox in the list of word kinds; when ticked, SQL keywords such as SELECT and FROM are drawn in bold.

literals_strings_numbers_null.location: Settings → Editor → General → Bold text: checkbox in the list of word kinds; when ticked, literal values (quoted strings, numbers and NULL) are drawn in bold.

match_camel_humps_initials.value: 將駱駝的駝峰與首字母配對
match_camel_humps_initials.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Matching: checkbox that lets completion match typed capitals or initials against CamelCase name parts (e.g. ST finds SomeTable).

order_by_lists.location: Settings → Editor → General → Automagic commas: checkbox that enables automatic comma insertion between items of an ORDER BY list; ORDER BY is a SQL keyword and stays in English.

procedures.location: Settings → Editor → General → Bold text: checkbox in the list of word kinds; when ticked, names of stored procedures from the connected database are drawn in bold.

procedures_2.location: Settings → Editor → General → Feedback report object kinds: checkbox that makes the Improve IntelliSense dialog list stored procedures by default (not the Bold text option of the same name).

read_dates_typed_plain_words.value: 閱讀以文字形式輸入的日期
read_dates_typed_plain_words.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: main checkbox that turns on reading plain-word dates such as “today” or “last wed at 3” after a date comparison.

refresh_dates_on_run.value: 每次查詢執行時刷新日期
refresh_dates_on_run.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: checkbox that re-evaluates every “--sqlly date:” comment automatically just before the query runs.

schemas.location: Settings → Editor → General → Bold text: checkbox in the list of word kinds; when ticked, schema names (such as dbo) from the connected database are drawn in bold.

select_lists.location: Settings → Editor → General → Automagic commas: checkbox that enables automatic comma insertion between items of a SELECT column list; SELECT is a SQL keyword and stays in English.

show_ai_query_summary_bar.value: 顯示 AI 查詢摘要欄
show_ai_query_summary_bar.location: Settings → Editor → General → Display: checkbox that turns on the bar above the results showing an AI-generated plain-language summary of the query tab's SQL; off by default.

show_line_numbers.location: Settings → Editor → General → Display: checkbox that shows or hides the line-number gutter on the left of every query editor.

show_refresh_buttons.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: checkbox that shows refresh buttons in the editor next to “--sqlly date:” comments and on the statement's first line for re-evaluating dates.

signature_help.value: 在函式調用中顯示簽署說明
signature_help.location: Settings → Editor → General → Display: checkbox that shows parameter help (the function's parameter list) while the caret is inside the parentheses of a function or procedure call.

system_data_types.location: Settings → Editor → General → Bold text: checkbox in the list of word kinds; when ticked, built-in data type names such as int or varchar are drawn in bold.

tables.location: Settings → Editor → General → Feedback report object kinds: checkbox that makes the Improve IntelliSense dialog list tables by default.

tables_views.location: Settings → Editor → General → Bold text: checkbox in the list of word kinds; when ticked, table and view names from the connected database are drawn in bold.

turn_periods_into_ranges.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: checkbox that turns a typed period (today, November, last week) into a start-to-end date range instead of a single moment.

types.location: Settings → Editor → General → Feedback report object kinds: checkbox that makes the Improve IntelliSense dialog list user-defined data types by default.

user_defined_functions.location: Settings → Editor → General → Bold text: checkbox in the list of word kinds; when ticked, names of user-defined functions from the connected database are drawn in bold.

user_defined_types.location: Settings → Editor → General → Bold text: checkbox in the list of word kinds; when ticked, names of user-defined data types from the connected database are drawn in bold.

views.location: Settings → Editor → General → Feedback report object kinds: checkbox that makes the Improve IntelliSense dialog list views by default.

vim_keybindings_modal_editing.value: Vim 鍵盤綁定（模式編輯）
vim_keybindings_modal_editing.location: Settings → Editor → General → Display: checkbox that turns on Vim-style modal editing (Normal, Insert and Visual modes) in the query editor; off by default.

binary_not_found.value: 找不到編輯器二進位檔：{path}
binary_not_found.location: Workbench → Status bar → Open in external editor: error detail shown when the configured editor program does not exist; {path} is the configured program path.

browser_unavailable.location: Workbench → Status bar → Open in external editor (browser build): clause saying external editors are unavailable, inserted as {feature} into the browser-preview notice inside “Failed to launch editor: …”.

launch_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar → Open in external editor: error detail shown when the external editor program could not be started; {reason} is the system error text.

no_binary_path.value: 未設定編輯器二進位檔路徑
no_binary_path.location: Workbench → Status bar → Open in external editor: error detail shown when opening the query tab in the external editor fails because no editor program path is set in settings.

sandbox_command_line_editor.value: 正在開啟命令列編輯器
sandbox_command_line_editor.location: Mac App Store edition → Workbench → Open in external editor: feature description inserted as {feature} into the sandbox restriction message when a command-line editor program cannot be started.

sandbox_terminal_editor.value: 正在開啟終端機編輯器
sandbox_terminal_editor.location: Mac App Store edition → Workbench → Open in external editor: feature description inserted as {feature} into the sandbox restriction message when a terminal editor (vim, nano, …) cannot be opened in a terminal window.

temp_files_unavailable.location: Workbench → Status bar → Open in external editor (browser build): lowercase clause saying temporary files are unavailable, inserted as {feature} into the browser-preview notice inside “Failed to write temp file: …”.

write_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar → Open in external editor: error detail shown when the temporary file holding the tab's SQL cannot be written or read back; {reason} is the system error text.

other.location: Settings → Editor → External Editors → Default editor: last dropdown option, for a custom editor not in the list; choosing it shows Name and Binary path fields. Also the fallback display name of that custom editor.

external_editors.location: Settings → Editor → External Editors: large heading at the top of the External Editors pane, where the outside text editor SQLLY opens content in is chosen.

general.location: Settings → Editor → General: large heading at the top of the General pane of the Editor settings group, naming the pane for basic query-editor behavior.

intellisense.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense: large heading at the top of the IntelliSense pane, which controls how completion suggestions are matched and inserted.

tabs.location: Settings → Editor → Tabs: large heading at the top of the Tabs pane, which controls which query tabs reopen at launch and what happens to them on disconnect.

ai_summary_bar.value: 每個查詢標籤頁 SQL 的簡明語言摘要，在此機器的本機 AI 執行時產生，並顯示在結果上方。預設為關閉；摘要模型位於 AI ▸ 裝置上。
ai_summary_bar.location: Settings → Editor → General → Display: help text under the “Show AI query summary bar” checkbox explaining the summary is made by the on-device AI runtime and where to pick its model (AI ▸ On device).

alias_insert_scope.value: 在 FROM 和 JOIN 之後套用；當別名設定為「不建議」時無效果。
alias_insert_scope.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → When you accept a table or view: help text under the AS-keyword checkbox noting alias insertion only happens after FROM/JOIN and is ignored when Alias names is “Do not suggest”.

automagic_commas_help.value: 按子句選擇加入。當新項目在下一個縮進行開始時，SQLLY 會修復缺失的分隔符，而不更改字串、註解或無關運算式。
automagic_commas_help.location: Settings → Editor → General → Automagic commas: help text under the section heading explaining each clause is opt-in and that only the missing separator is repaired when a new item starts on the next indented line.

bare_day_month_help.value: 在未說明「上次」或「下次」時，指出哪一個星期三 wed 或哪一年十一月 november。
bare_day_month_help.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: help text under the “A day or month on its own” dropdown explaining it applies when no “last” or “next” is typed; quoted words stay as English examples.

bold_text_help.value: 將這些類型的單字加粗。程序、架構、使用者定義函式、資料表和使用者定義類型可以從已連線資料庫的資料模型中識別。
bold_text_help.location: Settings → Editor → General → Bold text: help text under the section heading explaining that the ticked word kinds are drawn bold and that object names come from the connected database's data model.

camel_hump_match_help.value: SoTa 或 ST 會找到 SomeTable；PoOr 將 PurchaseOrder 排在 Poor 之前。當關閉時，建議會匹配名稱的任何部分並忽略大小寫：sometab 或 TABLE 會找到 SomeTable。
camel_hump_match_help.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Matching: help text under the camel-humps checkbox giving examples of matching when on and off; example identifiers must stay unchanged.

date_comment_help.value: 該註解會記住你的單字，因此日期可以稍後重新評估，這對於像昨天或本月這樣的已儲存查詢非常方便。
date_comment_help.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: help text under the “Keep what I typed…” checkbox explaining the comment lets the date be recomputed later, useful for saved queries.

date_like_column_names.value: 當資料模型不知道某欄位的類型時，像 OrderDate、created_at 或 ModifiedOn 這樣的名稱會被視為日期。
date_like_column_names.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: help text under the “Treat columns named like dates…” checkbox giving example column names; the names stay unchanged.

date_refresh_buttons_help.value: 每個 --sqlly date: 註解後的 ↻ 會重新評估該日期；語句第一行的 Refresh dates 按鈕會重新評估所有日期。
date_refresh_buttons_help.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: help text under “Show refresh buttons” describing the circular-arrow symbol after each date comment and the Refresh dates button; the symbol stays unchanged.

feedback_full_model_help.value: 在「改進 IntelliSense」對話方塊中預先勾選「包括全部」——僅物件名稱，從不包括資料。
feedback_full_model_help.location: Settings → Editor → General → IntelliSense: help text under the “Include full data model…” checkbox clarifying it pre-ticks “Include all” in that dialog and that only object names, never data, are sent.

fiscal_year_help.value: 針對本財政年度、上一財政年度及財政年度迄今。財政年度是以其結束的日曆年份命名的。
fiscal_year_help.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: help text under the “Fiscal year starts in” dropdown listing affected phrases and explaining a fiscal year is named for the calendar year it ends in.

highlight_occurrences_help.value: 選取一個單字或短語會像 VS Code 一樣柔和地高亮顯示它在腳本中出現的其他位置，所以重複的名稱和值一目了然。高亮會跟隨選取，且永不改變文字。
highlight_occurrences_help.location: Settings → Editor → General → Selection: help text under the “Highlight occurrences of selection” checkbox describing the VS Code–style highlight and noting it never changes the text.

detect_query_placeholders_help.value: 像 WHERE id = :id 這樣的佔位符會在結果上方的參數欄中獲取輸入，而執行時會填入你輸入的內容而不改變你的腳本。數字、true/false 和 NULL 會按原樣讀取；其他任何內容都會被視為文字，而加引號（'42'）則強制為文字。在 SQL Server 上，腳本從未 DECLARE 的 @name 也以相同方式運作。字串和註解中的佔位符會被忽略。
detect_query_placeholders_help.location: Settings → Editor → General → Query parameters: help text under the placeholder checkbox explaining that values are entered in the Parameters strip and how they are read.

period_ranges_help.value: 使用 = 時，today、november 或 last week 會變成涵蓋整個期間的範圍；使用 <> 時，範圍會被排除。> 和 <= 與期間的最後時刻比較，>= 和 < 與期間的第一時刻比較。當關閉時，一個期間表示其第一時刻。
period_ranges_help.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: help text under “Turn periods into ranges” explaining how each comparison operator uses the period's first or last moment; operators stay unchanged.

plain_dates_help.value: 在進行日期比較，例如 OrderDate = 或 created_at >= 時，按下 Ctrl+Shift+Space，然後輸入 today、last wed at 3、november、ytd 或 past 7 days。卡片會顯示其含義；按 Enter 寫入匹配的日期。在其他地方，這個快速鍵仍然會尋找欄位值。
plain_dates_help.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: help text under the plain-words checkbox explaining how to trigger it with Ctrl+Shift+Space after a date comparison; example words and column names stay unchanged.

range_style_help.value: BETWEEN 讀起來很自然，並以欄位能儲存的最後時刻結束（SQL Server datetime 為 23:59:59.997）。半開區間形式對任何精度都是精確的，但會重複命名欄位二次。
range_style_help.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: help text under the Range style dropdown comparing the BETWEEN form with the half-open form; SQL keywords and the time value stay unchanged.

restore_tabs_help.value: 工作區檔案總是保留每個標籤；這僅控制會重新開啟哪些標籤。
restore_tabs_help.location: Settings → Editor → Tabs → Restore tabs at launch: help text under the restore options clarifying all tabs stay saved in the workspace file and the choice only affects what reopens.

schema_name_search.value: dboM 或 dbom 可找到 dbo.Make。當關閉時，只有物件本身的名稱會被搜尋，除非你輸入模式和一個點（dbo.m）。
schema_name_search.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Matching: help text under the “Include schema name in searching” checkbox with examples of the on and off behavior; example names stay unchanged.

source_help.value: 內建使用本機解析器；Rust 引擎則執行較完整的 ffi 支援解析器。
source_help.location: Settings → Editor → General → IntelliSense: help text under the Source dropdown explaining the difference between the Built-in and Rust engine options.

terminal_editor_note.value: 這是一個終端編輯器；它會在新的終端視窗中開啟。
terminal_editor_note.location: Settings → Editor → External Editors: help text shown at the bottom of the pane when the selected editor is a terminal program (such as nano or vi), saying it will open in a new Terminal window.

to_date_range_end.value: 適用於 ytd、mtd、今年迄今為止、過去 7 天等等。
to_date_range_end.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: help text under the “To-date periods end” dropdown listing which phrases it affects; ytd and mtd are typed abbreviations and stay unchanged.

vim_mode_keys.value: Esc 進入一般模式；i / a / o 進入插入模式。移動命令 h j k l w b e 0 $ gg G，操作命令 d c y 搭配 dd / yy / cc，x，p / P，u 和 Ctrl+R，v 進入視覺模式，/ 開啟尋找。
vim_mode_keys.location: Settings → Editor → General → Display: help text under the Vim keybindings checkbox listing the supported Vim keys and motions; key letters and symbols must stay unchanged.

external_editors_intro.value: 選擇用來從結果網格中開啟結構化資料（JSON / XML）值的預設編輯器。
external_editors_intro.location: Settings → Editor → External Editors: introductory sentence under the pane heading saying the chosen editor opens JSON / XML values from the results grid.

feedback_kinds_intro.value: 改善 IntelliSense 對話方塊預設列出的物件類型。可在對話方塊中按報告進行調整；選擇一個資料表時，總是包含其所有欄位和外鍵。
feedback_kinds_intro.location: Settings → Editor → General → Feedback report object kinds: explanatory paragraph under the section heading; notes the choice can be changed per report and that picking a table always includes its columns and foreign keys.

general_intro.value: 配置基本編輯器行為 — 行號、粗體文字和縮排。
general_intro.location: Settings → Editor → General: introductory sentence under the pane heading summarizing what the pane controls (line numbers, bold text, indentation).

intellisense_intro.value: 完成建議的匹配和插入方式。這些設定適用於每個查詢標籤頁。
intellisense_intro.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense: introductory sentences under the pane heading saying the settings govern suggestion matching and insertion in every query tab.

tabs_intro.value: 選擇啟動時返回哪些標籤頁，以及斷開連線時標籤頁的處理方式。
tabs_intro.location: Settings → Editor → Tabs: introductory sentence under the pane heading summarizing the launch-restore and disconnect options below.

comma_placement.location: Settings → Editor → General → Automagic commas: label beside the Trailing / Leading radio pair choosing where automatically inserted commas go.

date_periods_end.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: label beside the dropdown choosing where to-date periods (ytd, mtd, past 7 days) stop: end of today or the current moment.

day_month_its_own.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: label beside the dropdown deciding which occurrence a bare weekday or month name (e.g. “wed”, “november”) refers to.

fiscal_year_starts.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: label beside the month dropdown choosing the month a fiscal year begins in.

range_style.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: label beside the dropdown choosing how a date range is written in SQL (BETWEEN … AND … or a >= … AND < … pair).

source.location: Settings → Editor → General → IntelliSense: label beside the dropdown that picks the completion engine (Built-in or Rust engine) used for suggestions.

spaces_per_tab.location: Settings → Editor → General → Indentation: label beside a − / + number stepper setting how many spaces one indent level (one press of Tab) is worth.

time_without_am_pm.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: label beside the dropdown deciding how an hour typed without am or pm (e.g. “at 3”) is read.

weeks_start.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: label beside the Sunday / Monday dropdown choosing the first day of the week for phrases like “this week” or “last week”.

reset_default.location: Settings → Editor → External Editors → Binary path: button under the path field that discards a custom path and restores the chosen editor's standard install path; shown for listed editors, not Other.

april.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience → Fiscal year starts: month option April.

august.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience → Fiscal year starts: month option August.

december.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience → Fiscal year starts: month option December.

february.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience → Fiscal year starts: month option February.

january.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience → Fiscal year starts: month option January.

july.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience → Fiscal year starts: month option July.

june.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience → Fiscal year starts: month option June.

march.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience → Fiscal year starts: month option March.

may.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience → Fiscal year starts: month option May.

november.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience → Fiscal year starts: month option November.

october.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience → Fiscal year starts: month option October.

september.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience → Fiscal year starts: month option September.

at_end_today.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience → To-date periods end: dropdown option making ytd/mtd-style ranges run through the end of the current day.

bare_hour_24h.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience → A time without am/pm: dropdown option reading bare hours on a 24-hour clock; the example shows “at 3” becoming 3:00 AM.

bare_hour_business.value: 1 到 7 是下午時間（3 點 = 下午 3:00）
bare_hour_business.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience → A time without am/pm: dropdown option reading hours 1 to 7 as afternoon (business hours); the example in parentheses shows “at 3” becoming 3:00 PM.

means_most_recent_one.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience → A day or month on its own: dropdown option meaning a bare weekday or month refers to the most recent past one.

means_next_one.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience → A day or month on its own: dropdown option meaning a bare weekday or month refers to the next upcoming one.

means_week_s_year_s.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience → A day or month on its own: dropdown option meaning a bare weekday is the one in the current week and a bare month the one in the current year.

monday.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience → Weeks start on: dropdown option making weeks begin on Monday.

right_now.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience → To-date periods end: dropdown option making ytd/mtd-style ranges stop at the current moment.

sunday.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience → Weeks start on: dropdown option making weeks begin on Sunday.

alias_from_capitals.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Alias names: radio option that builds the alias from the table name's capital letters in lower case; the example in parentheses stays unchanged.

alias_on_second_accept.value: 提供別名作為第二個建議（再次按 Enter 或 Tab 以新增它）
alias_on_second_accept.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → When you accept a table or view: radio option that instead offers the alias as a follow-up suggestion, added only when Enter or Tab is pressed again.

all_tabs.location: Settings → Editor → Tabs → Restore tabs at launch: radio option that reopens every query tab from the last session when SQLLY starts.

auto_add_alias.value: 自動新增別名（Orders AS o）
auto_add_alias.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → When you accept a table or view: radio option that inserts the generated alias right after the table name immediately; example stays unchanged.

auto_based_join.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Alias names: radio option that picks the alias automatically depending on the join being written.

close_tabs.value: 關閉連線的分頁（已固定及未儲存的分頁會保留）
close_tabs.location: Settings → Editor → Tabs → When disconnecting: radio option that closes the disconnected connection's query tabs, except pinned tabs and tabs with unsaved changes.

disconnect_clear_results.value: 保留分頁但清除其結果
disconnect_clear_results.location: Settings → Editor → Tabs → When disconnecting: radio option that keeps the connection's query tabs open but empties their results panes.

do_not_suggest.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Alias names: radio option that turns table alias suggestions off entirely.

keep_tabs_results.location: Settings → Editor → Tabs → When disconnecting: radio option that keeps the connection's query tabs open with their results still shown.

leading.location: Settings → Editor → General → Automagic commas → Comma placement: radio option that puts the inserted comma at the start of the new line, before the next item.

none_start_empty_query.location: Settings → Editor → Tabs → Restore tabs at launch: radio option that reopens no tabs and starts SQLLY with a single empty query tab.

pinned_tabs_only.location: Settings → Editor → Tabs → Restore tabs at launch: radio option that reopens only pinned query tabs when SQLLY starts.

spaces.location: Settings → Editor → General → Indentation: radio option meaning indent with space characters instead of tab characters; pairs with the Tabs option above it.

tabs.location: Settings → Editor → General → Indentation: radio option meaning indent with tab characters; the noun “tabs” here is the tab character, not editor tabs.

trailing.location: Settings → Editor → General → Automagic commas → Comma placement: radio option that puts the inserted comma at the end of the previous line.

accept_table_view.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → When you accept a table or view: section heading (a sentence fragment) above the options for what happens when a table or view completion is accepted.

alias_names.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Alias names: section heading above the radio options choosing how table aliases are generated when a table is completed.

automagic_commas.location: Settings → Editor → General → Automagic commas: section heading for options that automatically insert missing commas and AND connectors when a list item continues on a new line; “automagic” is a playful word for automatic.

binary_path.location: Settings → Editor → External Editors: section heading above the text field holding the full path to the chosen editor's executable program.

bold_text.location: Settings → Editor → General → Bold text: section heading above the checkboxes that choose which kinds of SQL words the editor draws in bold.

date_time_convenience.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense → Date & time convenience: section heading above the options for typing dates in plain words (today, last week, ytd) and turning them into SQL date values.

default_editor.location: Settings → Editor → External Editors: section heading above the dropdown listing the supported external editors to choose from.

disconnecting.location: Settings → Editor → Tabs → When disconnecting: section heading (sentence fragment) above the options for what happens to a connection's query tabs when it is disconnected.

display.location: Settings → Editor → General → Display: section heading above the checkboxes that control what the query editor draws (line numbers, statement frame, hover cards, hints, AI summary bar, Vim mode).

feedback_report_object_kinds.location: Settings → Editor → General → Feedback report object kinds: section heading above checkboxes choosing which database object kinds the Improve IntelliSense dialog lists by default.

indentation.location: Settings → Editor → General → Indentation: section heading above the Tabs / Spaces choice and the spaces-per-tab stepper that control what the Tab key inserts.

intellisense.location: Settings → Editor → General: section heading above the IntelliSense Source dropdown and the IntelliSense feedback report options, near the bottom of the General pane.

matching.location: Settings → Editor → IntelliSense: section heading above the checkboxes that control how typed text is matched against completion suggestions (camel-hump initials, schema-name search).

name.location: Settings → Editor → External Editors: section heading above the text input for the display name of a custom editor; shown only when “Other” is chosen in the Default editor dropdown.

navigation.location: Settings → Editor → General: section heading above the camel-hump word movement checkbox, grouping options for how keyboard word-jumps move the caret.

restore_tabs_at_launch.location: Settings → Editor → Tabs: section heading above the radio buttons choosing which query tabs reopen when the app starts (all, pinned only, or none).

selection.location: Settings → Editor → General: section heading above the checkbox that softly highlights other occurrences of the selected word or phrase in the editor.

query_parameters.location: Settings → Editor → General: section heading above the checkbox that turns :name, ? and $1 placeholders written in a query into rows of the Parameters strip.

spacing.location: Settings → Editor → General: section heading above the Auto spacing checkbox, which inserts spaces around SQL operators and punctuation as you type.

invalid_file.value: 不是有效的 VS Code 程式碼片段檔案：{error}
invalid_file.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Import from VS Code: error shown under the import buttons when the chosen VS Code / Azure Data Studio snippet file is not valid JSON; {error} is the parser's explanation.

not_an_object.value: 不是 VS Code 程式碼片段檔案：需要命名程式碼片段的物件。
not_an_object.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Import from VS Code: error shown under the import buttons when the chosen file is JSON but not a VS Code snippet file (its top level is not an object of named snippets).

final_stop_has_default.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Snippet body: validation error shown under the body field and on Save when the final cursor stop $0 is given default text; $0 must stay a plain marker.

unsupported_syntax.value: 不支援的程式碼片段語法：{kind}
unsupported_syntax.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Snippet body: validation error when the body uses snippet syntax SQLLY does not support; {kind} is an untranslated English word: variable, choice, transform or nested.

unterminated_placeholder.value: 位元 {byte} 的佔位符未終止
unterminated_placeholder.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Snippet body: validation error when a ${…} placeholder in the body is never closed with a brace; {byte} is the character offset where it starts.

app_store_edition_notice.value: 僅在 Mac App Store 版本中，只有 Mac 應用程式的編輯器可開啟；命令列和終端機編輯器無法啟動。
app_store_edition_notice.location: Settings → Editor → External Editors: notice box at the top of the pane in the Mac App Store edition only, saying terminal and command-line editors cannot be launched; a “see Help” sentence follows it.

camel_hump_hint_ctrl.value: Ctrl+Left / Ctrl+Right（加上 Shift 以選取）會在單字內的每個大寫字母處停下，以及在每個單字的起始和結尾處停下，而不是跳過空格到下一個單字。例如：在 SalesOrderLineId 中，游標會停在 Sales | Order | Line | Id，並在 Id 之後再繼續。空格會被跳過；一連串的標點符號算作一次停頓。
camel_hump_hint_ctrl.location: Settings → Editor → General → Navigation: help paragraph under the camel-hump word movement checkbox on Windows and Linux, explaining where Ctrl+Left/Right stop inside and between words.

camel_hump_hint_option.value: Option+Left / Option+Right（加上 Shift 以選取）會在單字內的每個大寫字母處停下，以及在每個單字的起始和結尾處停下，而不是跳過空格到下一個單字。例如：在 SalesOrderLineId 中，游標會停在 Sales | Order | Line | Id，並在 Id 之後再繼續。空格會被跳過；一連串的標點符號算作一次停頓。
camel_hump_hint_option.location: Settings → Editor → General → Navigation: help paragraph under the camel-hump word movement checkbox on macOS, explaining where Option+Left/Right stop inside and between words.

external_editor_path_missing.value: 輸入編輯器可執行檔的路徑。
external_editor_path_missing.location: Settings → Editor → External Editors: warning under the Binary path field, shown when no executable path is set for the selected editor; prompts the user to fill it in.

path_not_found.value: 此路徑下不存在檔案。在修正之前，在此編輯器中開啟將會失敗。
path_not_found.location: Settings → Editor → External Editors: warning under the Binary path field, shown when the entered executable path does not exist on disk, so opening files in that editor will fail.

two_finger_result_scroll.value: 在結果集上啟用雙指捲動
two_finger_result_scroll.location: Settings → Results → Gestures → Results: checkbox that turns on two-finger trackpad scrolling to switch between tabbed result sets with left/right swipes.

gestures.location: Settings → Results → Gestures: page title at the top of the Gestures pane, which configures trackpad and modifier-key scrolling.

query_swap_hint.value: 啟用後，在查詢編輯器上用兩指滑動可以開啟查詢切換器並在開啟的查詢之間切換。所選軸的兩個方向都有效：垂直滑動時向上/向下頁面向前或向後，水平滑動時向左/向右。停用狀態下編輯器的捲動保持不變。
query_swap_hint.location: Settings → Results → Gestures → Query: help paragraph under the 2 finger query swap dropdown, explaining how swiping over the editor opens the query switcher and moves between open queries.

stacked_scroll_hint.value: 在堆疊結果中，滑動網格會捲動該結果集。按住所選的修改鍵同時捲動，可捲動整個結果堆疊；當捲動超過網格的頂端或底端時，會跳到相鄰的結果。啟用雙指結果捲動時，標籤結果可通過左右捲動切換結果標籤；堆疊網格則保持獨立捲動。
stacked_scroll_hint.location: Settings → Results → Gestures → Results: help paragraph under the scroll modifier dropdown, explaining scrolling inside a grid versus the whole stacked results area and tab switching.

pane_intro.value: 配置結果集和查詢切換的觸控板及修改捲動行為。
pane_intro.location: Settings → Results → Gestures: introductory sentence under the pane title summarizing that the pane controls trackpad and modifier-scroll behavior.

multi_result_scroll_modifier.value: 多結果容器捲動修改鍵
multi_result_scroll_modifier.location: Settings → Results → Gestures → Results: label of the dropdown choosing which modifier key (None, Shift, Command, Control…) makes scrolling move the whole stack of results instead of one grid.

two_finger_query_swap.location: Settings → Results → Gestures → Query: label of the dropdown (Disabled / Vertical / Horizontal) choosing the swipe axis for switching between open query tabs; keep it short.

none.location: Settings → Results → Gestures: modifier summary shown when no modifier keys are selected.
Settings → Results → Gestures → Results: first option in the multi-result scroll modifier dropdown meaning no modifier key is required; other options are key names such as Shift.

query.location: Settings → Results → Gestures: section heading above the 2 finger query swap dropdown, grouping gestures that act on query editor tabs (noun, as in the query editor).

results.location: Settings → Results → Gestures: section heading above the two-finger result-set scrolling checkbox and scroll modifier dropdown, grouping gestures that act on result grids.

limit_scroll_repaints.value: 將捲動重繪限制為每秒 60 次
limit_scroll_repaints.location: Settings → Results → Performance → Scrolling: checkbox that paces results-grid repaints while scrolling to 60 per second.

detailed_query_timing.value: 顯示詳細的查詢時間統計
detailed_query_timing.location: Settings → Results → Performance → Query Timing: checkbox that adds the detailed per-query timing breakdown to the results status bar.

enable_query_version_history.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Version History: checkbox that turns on per-tab version history, which saves snapshots of the editor text you can later restore.

git_local_history.value: 顯示檔案支援分頁的 Git 本機歷史紀錄
git_local_history.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Git: checkbox that lists recent git commits for a tab’s file in the History panel when that file is inside a git repository.

library_connection_hint.value: 在函式庫檔案上顯示連線提示
library_connection_hint.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → SQL Library: checkbox that shows each library file’s remembered connection name beside it in the Library panel.

persist_last_results.value: 在重新啟動後保留每個分頁的最後結果
persist_last_results.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Result Cache: checkbox (desktop only) that saves each tab’s last result grid to disk so it reappears after the app restarts.

store_query_results_versions.value: 以版本方式儲存查詢結果
store_query_results_versions.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Result Storage: checkbox that saves the query results alongside each sealed version, so restoring a version also shows its results.

performance.location: Settings → Results → Performance: page title at the top of the Performance pane, which tunes query timing display and large result-set memory and paging.

query_history.location: Settings → Editor → Query History: page title at the top of the Query History pane covering version history, execution history, result caching, git history and the SQL Library.

git_history_hint.value: 檔案的最近提交唯讀清單，在分頁的檔案位於 Git 工作目錄內時，會顯示於歷史紀錄面板中。
git_history_hint.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Git: help text under the git local history checkbox, describing the read-only commit list shown in the History panel for files in a git work tree.

idle_rollback_hint.value: 適用於手動提交模式的分頁。0 不允許；最小值為 30。如果套用程式被終止，伺服器將保持交易直到自身的空閒交易逾時。
idle_rollback_hint.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Manual Commit Mode: help text under the idle rollback seconds field, giving the minimum and what happens to an open transaction if the app is killed.

idle_seal_hint.value: 在您停止編輯的秒數達到此數時，編輯器文字將封存為一個版本。最小值為 1。
idle_seal_hint.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Version History: help text under the Idle seal interval field, explaining that a pause in typing of that many seconds saves a version.

library_folder_hint.value: 子資料夾在「資料庫面板」中會變成資料夾。檔案是純 .sql；可選的第一行 `-- sqlly: connection="Name" database=db` 會記住目標連線。
library_folder_hint.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → SQL Library: help text under the Library folder field explaining folder mapping and the optional first-line comment that remembers a connection; keep the code sample unchanged.

lifecycle_hint.value: 關閉未命名的分頁會刪除其整個歷史紀錄。基於檔案的分頁會在各次工作階段間保留其歷史紀錄。
lifecycle_hint.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Lifecycle: help text explaining that closing an unsaved untitled tab discards its version history, while tabs backed by files keep it.

max_versions_eviction.value: 最舊的版本會在超過此數量時被清除。
max_versions_eviction.location: Settings → Editor → Query History: help text under the Maximum versions per tab field (listed after the Manual Commit Mode rollback setting), saying the oldest saved versions are deleted once a tab exceeds that number.

memory_budget_hint.value: 每個結果集在記憶體中保留的預覽資料的約略上限（以 MiB 計）。溢出列閾值限制了預覽列數；此預算會更早停止寬列。範圍為 1 到 2048 MiB。下一次查詢時生效。
memory_budget_hint.location: Settings → Results → Performance → Query Result Optimizations: help text under the Result memory budget field, explaining the per-result-set memory cap, its range, and when it applies.

no_cached_models.value: 尚未快取任何資料庫。SQLLY 會在第一次瀏覽資料庫架構時自動建立快取。
no_cached_models.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache → Cached data models: empty-state message shown in place of the cache list when no database schemas have been cached yet.

page_chunk_hint.value: 在捲動時每頁載入的行數；為了保持記憶體穩定，另一端會釋放相同數量的行。
page_chunk_hint.location: Settings → Results → Performance → Query Result Optimizations: help text under the Page chunk size field, explaining how many rows load per page and that as many are released.

page_margin_hint.value: 在下一個區塊中，捲動時在已載入邊緣頁面的這些行內。
page_margin_hint.location: Settings → Results → Performance → Query Result Optimizations: help text under the Page-in margin field, explaining how close to the loaded edge scrolling must get before the next chunk loads.

resident_rows.value: 在檢視中的行之前和之後保留的行數。
resident_rows.location: Settings → Results → Performance → Query Result Optimizations: help text under the Resident rows around view field, describing the rows kept in memory above and below the visible ones.

result_cache_hint.value: 恢復的分頁會在橫幅下顯示其緩存結果，直到您再次執行查詢。較大的結果不會被緩存。
result_cache_hint.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Result Cache: help text under the keep last results checkbox, saying reopened tabs show cached results under a banner until rerun.

retention_cleanup_hint.value: 在開啟查詢歷史記錄時會進行清理。固定的語句單獨儲存，永遠不會被保留政策刪除。
retention_cleanup_hint.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Execution History Browser: help text under the retention fields, saying old executions are pruned when Query History opens and pinned statements are kept.

spill_threshold_hint.value: 大於此行數的結果集將從磁碟臨時檔案提供，而不是儲存在記憶體中。對下一個查詢生效。
spill_threshold_hint.location: Settings → Results → Performance → Query Result Optimizations: help text under the Spill row threshold field, explaining that bigger result sets are read from a disk file.

storage_eviction_hint.value: 當超過上限時，結果負載會在 SQL 條目之前被清除。
storage_eviction_hint.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Result Storage: help text under the maximum results storage per tab field, saying stored results are dropped before version SQL text when over the limit.

stored_results_hint.value: 恢復一個版本也會重新呈現其儲存的結果，以唯讀方式顯示，並帶有資訊性標誌。結果是二進位編碼並經過 gzip 壓縮的。
stored_results_hint.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Result Storage: help text under the store results with versions checkbox, explaining that restoring a version shows its saved results read-only.

limit_scroll_repaints_hint.value: 在 120 Hz 顯示器上，這大約將捲動所耗 CPU 減半，但流暢度略微下降。捲動總是停留在最新位置。對 60 Hz 顯示器無影響。
limit_scroll_repaints_hint.location: Settings → Results → Performance → Scrolling: help text under the 60-per-second repaint checkbox explaining the CPU saving on 120 Hz displays and the smoothness trade-off.

timing_breakdown_hint.value: 在結果狀態列中顯示每個查詢的 First / Query / Server / Paint / Wall / Latency 分解 — 包含 latency-subtract 和 hh:MM:ss 切換選項 — 預設為關閉；行數始終顯示。
timing_breakdown_hint.location: Settings → Results → Performance → Query Timing: help text under the detailed timing checkbox, listing the timing columns shown in the results status bar; First, Query, Server, Paint, Wall and Latency are labels.

version_size_limit_hint.value: 較大的結果集不會被儲存；版本僅保留其 SQL。
version_size_limit_hint.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Result Storage: help text under the maximum results per version field, saying results above that size are skipped and the version keeps only its SQL.

execution_retention_days.value: 保留執行紀錄數天（0 = 無限制）
execution_retention_days.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Execution History Browser: label of the number field giving how many days executions are kept; 0 means keep them forever.

idle_rollback_seconds.value: 在（秒）後回滾閒置手動交易
idle_rollback_seconds.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Manual Commit Mode: label of the number field setting how many idle seconds pass before an uncommitted manual-mode transaction is rolled back.

idle_seal_interval_seconds.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Version History: label of the number field setting how many idle seconds after typing stops before the editor text is saved as a version.

library_folder.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → SQL Library: label of the text field holding the disk folder whose .sql files appear in the Library panel; a Choose… button sits beside it.

max_cached_tab_mib.value: 每個標籤最大快取大小（MiB）
max_cached_tab_mib.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Result Cache: label of the number field limiting, in mebibytes, how large a tab’s cached last result may be on disk.

max_tab_results_mib.value: 每個標籤最大結果儲存（MiB）
max_tab_results_mib.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Result Storage: label of the number field capping, in mebibytes, the total stored results across all versions of one tab.

max_version_results_mib.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Result Storage: label of the number field giving the largest result, in mebibytes, that is stored with a single version.

maximum_cached_rows_per_tab.value: 每個標籤最大快取列數
maximum_cached_rows_per_tab.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Result Cache: label of the number field limiting how many result rows per tab are saved to disk for restore after restart.

maximum_execution_entries.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Execution History Browser: label of the number field capping how many past query executions are kept in the execution history.

maximum_versions_per_tab.location: Settings → Editor → Query History: label of the number field, listed after the Manual Commit Mode rollback setting, capping how many saved versions each query tab keeps before the oldest are removed.

page_chunk_size.location: Settings → Results → Performance → Query Result Optimizations: label of the number field setting how many rows are loaded from the spill file per page while scrolling.

page_margin.location: Settings → Results → Performance → Query Result Optimizations: label of the number field setting how many rows before the loaded edge scrolling triggers loading the next page.

resident_rows_around_view.location: Settings → Results → Performance → Query Result Optimizations: label of the number field setting how many rows stay in memory before and after the visible grid rows.

result_memory_budget_mib.location: Settings → Results → Performance → Query Result Optimizations: label of the number field setting the approximate memory cap, in mebibytes, for preview data of one result set.

spill_row_threshold.location: Settings → Results → Performance → Query Result Optimizations: label of the number field setting the row count above which a result set is written to a disk spill file.

performance_intro.value: 調整在捲動時大型結果集被寫入磁碟以及在記憶體中分頁進出的方法。
performance_intro.location: Settings → Results → Performance: introductory sentence under the pane title summarizing that it tunes disk spilling and memory paging of large result sets.

schema_cache_intro.value: SQLLY 將每個資料庫的結構快取到磁碟上，因此當你重新連線時，IntelliSense 和伺服器總管可以立即使用，而不必等待新的元資料抓取。清除快取可以回收其空間；下次開啟該資料庫時，SQLLY 會從伺服器重建快取。
schema_cache_intro.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache: introductory paragraph at the top of the pane explaining that database schemas are cached on disk, why, and what clearing a cache does.

version_history_intro.value: 查詢編輯器的每個分頁版本歷史。當你執行查詢或暫停編輯時，版本會被封存；可從歷史面板還原任何版本，而不會喪失目前的文字。
version_history_intro.location: Settings → Editor → Query History: introductory paragraph under the pane title explaining what per-tab version history is, when versions are saved, and where to restore them.

click_again_clear.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache: label of the Clear all button after its first click, asking for a second click to confirm; {value} is a counted phrase such as “3 caches”.

choose.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → SQL Library: small button beside the Library folder field that opens a folder picker to choose the library folder.

clear.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache → Cached data models: small button at the right of each cached database row that deletes that one cached schema.

clear_result_cache.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Result Cache: small button that deletes every tab’s cached last result from disk; the first click only arms it.

clear_result_cache_confirm.value: 再次點擊以清除快取結果
clear_result_cache_confirm.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Result Cache: label of the clear cached results button after its first click, asking for a second click to confirm the deletion.

cached_data_models.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache: section heading above the list of cached database schemas, grouped by server with each database’s size and age.

execution_history_browser.location: Settings → Editor → Query History: section heading above the retention-days and maximum-entries fields that limit the history of executed queries.

git.location: Settings → Editor → Query History: section heading above the checkbox that shows git commit history for tabs whose file is in a git repository.

lifecycle.location: Settings → Editor → Query History: section heading above the note explaining what happens to a tab’s version history when the tab is closed.

manual_commit_mode.location: Settings → Editor → Query History: section heading above the field that sets when idle uncommitted transactions in Manual commit mode tabs are rolled back.

scrolling.location: Settings → Results → Performance: section heading above the checkbox that limits results-grid repaints while scrolling.

query_result_optimizations.location: Settings → Results → Performance: section heading above the spill threshold, memory budget and paging fields for large result sets.

query_timing.location: Settings → Results → Performance: section heading above the checkbox that shows the detailed per-query timing breakdown in the results status bar.

result_cache.location: Settings → Editor → Query History: section heading (desktop only) above the options that keep each tab’s last results on disk across restarts, plus the clear-cache button.

result_storage.location: Settings → Editor → Query History: section heading above the options for saving query results together with each sealed version and the size limits for them.

sql_library.location: Settings → Editor → Query History: section heading above the Library folder field, Choose… button and connection-hint checkbox that configure the SQL Library panel.

version_history.location: Settings → Editor → Query History: section heading above the checkbox enabling version history and the idle seal interval field.

choose_library_folder.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → SQL Library: title or prompt of the system folder picker that opens after clicking Choose… beside the Library folder field.

clear_result_cache_warning.value: 刪除每個分頁的磁碟快取最後結果。恢復的分頁將顯示空結果，直到你再次執行。
clear_result_cache_warning.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Result Cache: warning shown under the clear cached results button after its first click, explaining what a confirming second click deletes.

auto_detect.location: Settings → Workspace → Advanced → Database tools: placeholder text “Auto-detect” in the associated search, naming, model, path, or auto-detection input.

default_model.location: Settings → AI → On device: placeholder text “Default model” in the associated search, naming, model, path, or auto-detection input.

describe_table.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Quick actions: placeholder text “Describe table” in the associated search, naming, model, path, or auto-detection input.

description.location: Settings → Editor → Snippets & Quick Actions → Snippets: placeholder text “Description” in the associated search, naming, model, path, or auto-detection input.

external_editor_name.location: Settings → Editor → External Editors: placeholder text “External editor name” in the associated search, naming, model, path, or auto-detection input.

library_folder.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → SQL Library: placeholder text “Library folder” in the associated search, naming, model, path, or auto-detection input.

model_id.location: Settings → AI → Cloud: placeholder text “model id” in the associated search, naming, model, path, or auto-detection input.

path_to_claude_or_codex.value: Claude 或 Codex 的路徑
path_to_claude_or_codex.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: placeholder text “Path to claude or codex” in the associated search, naming, model, path, or auto-detection input.

profile_name.location: Settings → AI → Cloud: placeholder text “Profile name” in the associated search, naming, model, path, or auto-detection input.

search.location: Settings → Sidebar: placeholder text “Search” in the associated search, naming, model, path, or auto-detection input.

search_commands.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts: placeholder text “Search commands…” in the associated search, naming, model, path, or auto-detection input.

token_budget.location: Settings → AI → Cloud: placeholder text “token budget” in the associated search, naming, model, path, or auto-detection input.

day_plural.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache → Cached data models: age shown after the size on a cached database row when it was cached several days ago; plural form, {count} is the number of days.

day_single.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache → Cached data models: age shown after the size on a cached database row when it was cached exactly 1 day ago; singular form, {count} is 1.

hour_plural.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache → Cached data models: age shown after the size on a cached database row when it was cached several hours ago; plural form, {count} is the number of hours.

hour_single.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache → Cached data models: age shown after the size on a cached database row when it was cached exactly 1 hour ago; singular form, {count} is 1.

minute_plural.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache → Cached data models: age shown after the size on a cached database row when it was cached several minutes ago; plural form, {count} is the number of minutes.

minute_single.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache → Cached data models: age shown after the size on a cached database row when it was cached exactly 1 minute ago; singular form, {count} is 1.

month_plural.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache → Cached data models: age shown after the size on a cached database row when it was cached several months ago; plural form, {count} is the number of months.

month_single.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache → Cached data models: age shown after the size on a cached database row when it was cached exactly 1 month ago; singular form, {count} is 1.

year_plural.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache → Cached data models: age shown after the size on a cached database row when it was cached several years ago; plural form, {count} is the number of years.

year_single.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache → Cached data models: age shown after the size on a cached database row when it was cached exactly 1 year ago; singular form, {count} is 1.

clear_all.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache: button that clears every cached data model.

clear_all_confirmation.value: 刪除 {count}；每次下次開啟時都會從新的伺服器拉取重新構建。
clear_all_confirmation.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache: confirmation warning after clicking Clear all once.

cache_plural.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache: plural count label for cache.

cache_single.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache: single count label for cache.

database_plural.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache: plural count label for database.

database_single.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache: single count label for database.

model_plural.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache: plural count label for model.

model_single.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache: single count label for model.

disk_summary.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache: summary of cached database count and disk size.

reveal_error_open_file_manager.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache → Reveal folder: lowercase clause inserted as {error} after “Failed to reveal the data-model cache folder:” when Finder, File Explorer, or the Linux file manager cannot be started; {detail} is the operating system's own error text.

reveal_error_prepare_folder.value: 無法準備資料夾以顯示: {detail}
reveal_error_prepare_folder.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache → Reveal folder: lowercase clause inserted as {error} after “Failed to reveal the data-model cache folder:” when the cache folder cannot be created first; {detail} is the operating system's own error text.

reveal_error_unsupported_os.value: 目前作業系統沒有檔案管理員命令
reveal_error_unsupported_os.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache → Reveal folder: lowercase clause inserted as {error} after “Failed to reveal the data-model cache folder:” when this operating system has no file-manager command SQLLY can run.

reveal_failed.value: 無法顯示資料模型快取資料夾: {error}
reveal_failed.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache: error logged when the operating system cannot reveal the cache folder.

reveal_unavailable.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache → Reveal folder (browser build): lowercase clause saying revealing a folder is unavailable, inserted as {feature} into the browser-preview notice that follows “Failed to reveal the data-model cache folder:”.

press_keys_esc_cancel.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → App Commands → Rebind: prompt shown while capturing a new application-command shortcut.

press_keys_esc_cancel_2.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions → Rebind: prompt shown while capturing a new editor-action shortcut.

add_cursor_above.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that adds another text cursor on the line above the current one, for multi-line editing, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

add_cursor_below.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that adds another text cursor on the line below the current one, for multi-line editing, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

add_cursor_next_occurrence.value: 為下一個出現位置新增游標
add_cursor_next_occurrence.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that selects the next occurrence of the selected word and adds a cursor there (multi-cursor editing), shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

add_line_comment.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that comments out the current or selected lines with a SQL line comment (always adds, unlike toggle), shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

column_select_down.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that extends a rectangular column (box) selection one line down, putting a cursor on each line, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

column_select_up.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that extends a rectangular column (box) selection one line up, putting a cursor on each line, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

convert_delimited_list.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that opens a dialog to convert the selected delimited text into a quoted SQL list; the ellipsis marks that a dialog opens, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

copy.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the standard SQL editor clipboard action that copies the selected text (verb, imperative), shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

cut.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the standard SQL editor clipboard action that cuts the selected text to the clipboard (verb, imperative), shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

delete_backward.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action bound to Backspace that deletes the character before the cursor, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

delete_forward.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action bound to the Delete key that deletes the character after the cursor, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

delete_line_end.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that deletes text from the cursor to the end of the current line, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

delete_line_start.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that deletes text from the cursor back to the start of the current line, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

delete_word_backward.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that deletes the whole word before the cursor, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

delete_word_forward.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that deletes the whole word after the cursor, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

dismiss_legacy_alias.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of an older, unbound-by-default SQL editor action kept for compatibility that does the same as “Dismiss Popup or Selection”; the parenthetical marks it as a legacy alias, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

dismiss_popup_selection.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action bound to Esc that closes the completion popup, hover card or ghost text, or clears the selection, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

duplicate_line.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that copies the current line and inserts the copy directly below it, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

execute_query.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action (Cmd+Enter or F5 by default) that runs the query in the editor, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

find.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that opens the find bar to search the query text (verb, imperative), shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

find_next.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that jumps to the next match of the current find-bar search, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

find_previous.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that jumps to the previous match of the current find-bar search, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

fold_all_regions.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that collapses every foldable code region in the query text at once, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

fold_region.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that collapses the foldable code region under the cursor, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

format_document.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that reformats the whole query text with the SQL formatter, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

format_selection.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that reformats only the selected SQL text with the SQL formatter, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

go_line.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that opens a prompt to jump the cursor to a typed line number, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

go_next_error.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action (F8 by default) that moves the cursor to the next SQL error or warning marked in the editor, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

improve_intellisense_capture_feedback.value: 改善 IntelliSense（收集意見回饋）
improve_intellisense_capture_feedback.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action (F2 by default) that, while the completion popup is open, captures its context and opens the IntelliSense feedback dialog, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

insert_distinct_values_as_list.value: 插入不同值為 IN 清單
insert_distinct_values_as_list.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action, unbound by default, that looks up distinct values of the column at the cursor and inserts them as a SQL IN (…) list, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

insert_newline.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action bound to Enter that breaks the line and inserts a new line at the cursor, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

join_lines.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that joins the next line onto the current one, trimming the whitespace between them, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

move_camelcase_left.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that moves the cursor left by one part of a camelCase or snake_case identifier rather than a whole word, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

move_camelcase_right.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that moves the cursor right by one part of a camelCase or snake_case identifier rather than a whole word, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

move_document_end.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that moves the cursor to the very end of the query text, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

move_document_start.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that moves the cursor to the very beginning of the query text, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

move_down.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action bound to the Down arrow that moves the cursor one line down, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

move_left.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action bound to the Left arrow that moves the cursor one character left, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

move_line_down.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that moves the current line (or selected lines) one line down, swapping with the line below, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

move_line_end.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action (End by default) that moves the cursor to the end of the current line, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

move_line_start.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action (Home by default) that moves the cursor to the start of the current line, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

move_line_up.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that moves the current line (or selected lines) one line up, swapping with the line above, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

move_right.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action bound to the Right arrow that moves the cursor one character right, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

move_up.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action bound to the Up arrow that moves the cursor one line up, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

move_word_left.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that moves the cursor left to the start of the previous word, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

move_word_right.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that moves the cursor right to the end of the next word, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

open_context_menu.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action (Shift+F10 or the Menu key) that opens the editor's right-click context menu from the keyboard, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

page_down.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action bound to Page Down that scrolls and moves the cursor down by one screen, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

page_up.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action bound to Page Up that scrolls and moves the cursor up by one screen, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

paste.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the standard SQL editor clipboard action that pastes clipboard text at the cursor (verb, imperative), shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

paste_as_list.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that pastes clipboard lines as a quoted, comma-separated SQL IN (…) list, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

qualify_identifier.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that offers to add or remove the schema/table qualifier on the identifier at the cursor or in the selection, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

redo.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the standard SQL editor action that reapplies the last undone edit (verb, imperative), shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

refresh_natural_language_dates.value: 重新整理自然語言日期
refresh_natural_language_dates.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that re-evaluates natural-language date phrases (such as “last Wednesday”) written in the query and updates their date literals, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

remove_line_comment.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that removes SQL line-comment markers from the current or selected lines (always uncomments, unlike toggle), shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

replace.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that opens the find bar with the replace field for search-and-replace (verb, imperative), shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

select_all.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that selects the entire query text, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

select_all_occurrences.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that selects every occurrence of the selected word at once with one cursor each, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

select_camelcase_left.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that extends the selection left by one part of a camelCase or snake_case identifier, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

select_camelcase_right.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that extends the selection right by one part of a camelCase or snake_case identifier, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

select_document_end.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that extends the selection from the cursor to the end of the query text, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

select_document_start.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that extends the selection from the cursor to the beginning of the query text, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

select_down.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action (Shift+Down by default) that extends the selection one line down, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

select_left.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action (Shift+Left by default) that extends the selection one character left, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

select_line_end.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action (Shift+End by default) that extends the selection to the end of the current line, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

select_line_start.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action (Shift+Home by default) that extends the selection to the start of the current line, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

select_page_down.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action (Shift+Page Down) that extends the selection down by one screen, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

select_page_up.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action (Shift+Page Up) that extends the selection up by one screen, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

select_right.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action (Shift+Right by default) that extends the selection one character right, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

select_up.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action (Shift+Up by default) that extends the selection one line up, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

select_word_left.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that extends the selection left to the start of the previous word, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

select_word_right.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action that extends the selection right to the end of the next word, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

shift_enter.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action bound to Shift+Enter that starts a new line and, inside a SELECT column list, adds the separating comma; the key-combination name may stay as is, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

shift_tab.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action bound to Shift+Tab that unindents the current or selected lines; the key-combination name may stay as is, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

tab.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action bound to the Tab key that accepts a completion or indents the current or selected lines; the key name may stay as is, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

toggle_line_comment.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action (Cmd+/ by default) that comments out the current or selected lines, or uncomments them if already commented, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

trigger_ai_inline_suggestion.value: 觸發 AI 行內建議
trigger_ai_inline_suggestion.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action (Option+Backslash by default) that asks the AI for an inline ghost-text completion at the cursor, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

trigger_completions.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action (Ctrl+Space by default) that opens the IntelliSense completion popup on demand, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.

trigger_value_lookup.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: name of the SQL editor action (Ctrl+Shift+Space) that opens a popup of actual column values for the comparison at the cursor, or a date helper inside a date comparison, shown as the row name beside its rebindable shortcut cell.
